channel.description: Latest Microsoft 365 Message Center messages. Message Center posts vary by tenant; always use your tenant's Message Center as the source of truth.

item.title: MC1528014: Microsoft Teams: Two presenters can share their screens or windows simultaneously in meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow two presenters to share screens simultaneously in meetings starting late November 2026. This feature enhances collaboration by displaying both shared contents at once. Tenant admins can control this setting, and meeting organizers can enable or disable it per meeting. No compliance issues identified.

item.title: MC1528013: Microsoft SharePoint: SharePoint Server access through the mobile apps will be retired
item.description: SharePoint Server access via the standalone SharePoint mobile apps for iOS and Android will be retired starting November 27, 2026. These apps will support SharePoint Online only. Organizations should notify users and update documentation accordingly before this change.

item.title: MC1528011: Microsoft Teams: External presenter support for event group chat
item.description: Microsoft Teams will support external presenters in event group chat for meetings with the "Enable Green room" option. Rollout starts November 2026. External collaboration must be enabled. External presenters can read and post messages, with tenant IDs updated accordingly, enabling cross-tenant communication.

item.title: MC1528009: Microsoft 365 admin center: Retirement of selected Search Analytics capabilities
item.description: Selected Search Analytics capabilities for Microsoft/Bing, Teams, Outlook/WXP, Windows Search Work results, and Microsoft365.com will retire in late 2026. Summary, User/Query, and Answer Analytics in Microsoft 365 admin center will be removed, but search functions and other analytics remain unaffected. Administrators should review and export needed data.

item.title: MC1528007: Join button will require HTTPS meeting links
item.description: Starting late November 2026, Outlook's Join button will only appear for meetings with HTTPS join URLs. Meetings with HTTP-only URLs will not show the button. Organizations should ensure their meeting providers and integrations generate HTTPS links to avoid impact. No action is needed if HTTPS URLs are already used.

item.title: MC1528006: Microsoft Authenticator: Improved backup and restore experience for Android
item.description: Microsoft Authenticator for Android will improve backup and restore with clearer setup guidance and support for passkeys starting mid-January 2027. Users must enable Google One backup and screen lock. Work/school accounts aren’t backed up, and backup works only in the Android personal profile. No admin action needed.

item.title: MC1528003: Microsoft Excel: Edit with Copilot in Excel on iPhone
item.description: Edit with Copilot in Excel on iPhone enables natural language editing and task continuation outside the app. Rolling out worldwide from late October to November 2026, it enhances mobile Excel use with secure Microsoft 365 integration, allowing quick data insights, edits, and formula updates without compliance concerns.

item.title: MC1528000: Microsoft Entra ID: Reminder to migrate from Microsoft-provided SMS and voice authentication
item.description: Microsoft Entra ID will retire Microsoft-provided SMS and voice authentication starting February 1, 2027. Organizations must migrate users to passkeys or other methods, or configure a customer-managed telecom provider before then to avoid sign-in disruptions. SMS and voice are vulnerable to attacks; passkeys are recommended.

item.title: MC1450134: Microsoft Entra: Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO as standalone MFA factors
item.description: Microsoft Entra will recognize Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO as standalone MFA factors starting early November 2026, allowing users to satisfy MFA without additional passkeys. No configuration changes are needed, but organizations should update onboarding and MFA registration guidance accordingly.

item.title: MC1422063: OneDrive for Business: Improved Windows Desktop sync error messages for max path length
item.description: OneDrive for Business will improve Windows desktop sync error messages for paths exceeding the 520-character limit, guiding users to rename or move items without stopping sync. This update, rolling out January 2027, aims to reduce confusion and support tickets with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1510951: Windows updates are available for 2026 time zone changes in Canada
item.description: Windows updates support 2026 time zone changes in Manitoba, Alberta, and British Columbia, effective November 1, 2026, when clocks won't be set back. Install updates before then and select the new region-specific time zones to ensure correct local time on devices. Guidance for Outlook and Microsoft 365 is provided.

item.title: MC1481315: Microsoft Purview: Retirement of Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) classic and DSPM for AI classic experiences
item.description: Microsoft Purview will retire DSPM classic and DSPM for AI classic by late January 2027, unifying capabilities into a single DSPM experience. Organizations using the classic versions must transition to the current DSPM experience for data security posture management, reporting, and investigations.

item.title: MC1478975: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Use Microsoft Agent 365 agents as connected agents in declarative agents
item.description: Microsoft 365 now supports Microsoft Agent 365 agents using the Agent2Agent protocol as connected agents in declarative agents, expanding integration options. Administrators manage and approve these agents via the Microsoft 365 admin center. This update enables new AI interactions and requires review of data compliance and governance.

item.description: Microsoft has published a new blog post outlining our response to the compromise of eMudhra intermediate certificate authority keys, including changes to the Windows and Microsoft Edge trust lists. item.title: MC1526712: Power Platform – Information about the 2026 time zone changes in Canada
item.description: What and why Power Platform services are being updated to support the 2026 time zone changes in Manitoba, Alberta, and British Columbia. This is a general awareness message to support the changes and complements MC1510951 — Windows updates are available for 2026 time zone changes in Canada. Rollout schedule Updates will be delivered by service to support the November 1, 2026, time zone transition. Availability will vary by service. item.description: What and why Dynamics 365 apps and Dataverse are being updated to add the new Canadian time zone definitions in support of the 2026 time zone changes in Manitoba, Alberta, and British Columbia. This is a general awareness message to support the changes and complements MC1510951 — Windows updates are available for 2026 time zone changes in Canada. item.title: MC1526679: Microsoft Teams Default meeting template
item.description: Default meeting templates let IT admins set organization-wide meeting options for Teams meetings scheduled via Outlook or Teams calendar, ensuring consistency and protection. Rolling out worldwide in November 2026, only Teams Premium licensed organizers can use them. Admins create and assign templates; some meeting types are excluded.

item.title: MC1526676: Microsoft 365 admin center: Manage authoritative sources for Microsoft 365 Copilot Search
item.description: Admins with Global admin or reader roles can manage up to 100 authoritative SharePoint Online sites in Microsoft 365 Copilot Search via the admin center, enhancing search relevance. This AI-driven feature rolls out worldwide in late September 2026 and includes centralized governance and bulk import/export capabilities.

item.title: MC1526668: Change Optics Report
item.description: The Change Optics report for Exchange Online is now generally available worldwide, helping admins identify email traffic affected by upcoming service changes. Accessible in the Exchange Admin Center, it highlights onmicrosoft.com external traffic and Direct Send traffic to aid investigation and remediation. No action required.

item.title: MC1441784: Microsoft Copilot for Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
item.description: Microsoft is updating the Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook to a new location next to the ribbon, offering easier access and AI-powered contextual recommendations. The rollout begins mid-November 2026 worldwide, with no changes to licensing or admin settings. No action is required, but user communication is recommended.

item.title: MC1472028: Outlook: Change the organizer of meetings
item.description: Microsoft is enabling Outlook users to transfer meeting organizer roles within their organization, improving meeting continuity during role changes or leave. The rollout begins November 2026 for non-online meetings, with phased support for Teams meetings and artifacts. The feature requires acceptance by the new organizer and preserves meeting content.

item.title: MC1526661: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Export Improvements
item.description: Microsoft 365 Apps Cloud Update will enhance export capabilities in Inventory and Cloud Update views, adding more device and update details, filtered exports, and new columns like Cloud Update Status. Rollout starts November 2026. No action or compliance changes are needed.

item.title: MC1526652: AI Builder credits retirement: Prepare to use Copilot Credits
item.description: Microsoft is retiring AI Builder credits by November 1, 2026, replacing them with Copilot Credits. Organizations must plan and purchase Copilot Credits before AI Builder credits expire to avoid service interruptions. AI Builder features continue, but licensing and credit management require admin action.

item.title: MC1526651: Microsoft Teams: Malicious QR code detection in messages
item.description: Microsoft Teams will detect malicious QR codes in messages, providing warnings for phishing or fraud threats starting November 2026. This applies to chats and channels, with QR code blurring for external senders. The feature is enabled by default via Malicious URL protection, requiring no admin action.

item.title: MC1492959: Audio Overview Updates
item.description: Microsoft is enhancing Audio Overview with topic-based episodes for easier navigation, support for more content types (OneNote, Loop, emails, Teams chats/meetings, .txt files), and sensitivity label inheritance when saving to OneDrive. The update rolls out globally from early to late November 2026 with no admin action needed.

item.title: MC1474106: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: New MessageContents table in Advanced Hunting for Microsoft Teams messages
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 introduces a new MessageContents table in Advanced Hunting for Teams messages, enabling authorized security analysts to query message snippets and metadata for threat investigations. Rollout is from late September to mid-November 2026. Access requires specific permissions and may impact security procedures.

item.title: MC1470410: Microsoft Teams: QR code protection for messages from external users
item.description: Microsoft Teams will blur QR code images from external users by default starting mid-October 2026 to reduce phishing risks. Users can reveal images if trusted. No admin action is needed, but admins should inform users and update related guidance. The feature applies across all Teams platforms automatically.

item.title: MC1506318: Copilot Studio - Information regarding the end of support for selected AI models
item.description: We are announcing the end of support for selected AI models on the Standard and GitHub Copilot harnesses in Copilot Studio. Beginning on each models' applicable migration date, the selected models will no longer be available in Copilot Studio, and agents will automatically migrate to a replacement model. item.title: MC1450133: Microsoft Entra: Users can register a passkey or passwordless sign-in as their first multifactor authentication method
item.description: Microsoft Entra will allow users to register passkeys or passwordless sign-in as their first multifactor authentication method, removing the prior requirement to set up alternate MFA methods first. The phased rollout begins November 2026, aiming to simplify strong authentication adoption and reduce registration friction.

item.title: MC1526468: Update to MC1510951: Canada 2026 time zone changes — Microsoft 365 impact and required admin actions
item.description: On November 1, 2026, certain Canadian regions will not change clocks, affecting Microsoft 365 scheduling. Admins must update Windows, Outlook time zones, review meetings, update Teams Rooms, and keep apps current. Testing and support case submission with #Canada Time-Zone are advised.

item.title: MC1473155: Microsoft Purview: permissions audit log improvements
item.description: Microsoft Purview is enhancing audit logging for role-based access control, adding two new audit operations to improve transparency and troubleshooting of access checks. This update, rolling out worldwide from late September to October 2026, requires no action and provides administrators better visibility into access evaluations.

item.title: MC1505607: Outlook: Reply With a Template in Rules
item.description: New Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web will let users create inbox rules to auto-reply with saved templates, automating repetitive responses. Rollout starts mid-October 2026 (Targeted Release) and completes by late December 2026 (General Availability). No admin action is required before rollout.

item.title: MC1261587: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Hard delete OneDrive and SharePoint files with priority cleanup workflow
item.description: Microsoft Purview introduces a priority cleanup workflow allowing admins to hard delete specific OneDrive and SharePoint content, even under retention or holds, with required eDiscovery approval. Rolling out mid-August 2026, it enhances data risk management and compliance without affecting user workflows unless configured by admins.

item.title: MC1492154: Enhanced M365 Copilot Memory - Copilot is now personalized with work data
item.description: M365 Copilot now uses Microsoft 365 data to provide personalized work responses, rolling out worldwide from early October to November 2026. Users can disable this via settings, and admins can control it with enhancedPersonalizationSetting. No admin action or compliance issues are required.

item.title: MC1239927: Microsoft 365 Copilot for Teams: Bilingual consecutive interpretation mode with Interpreter agent
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot for Teams introduces a new Consecutive Interpretation mode, enabling structured, turn-by-turn multilingual meetings. Rolling out from May to December 2026, it requires a Copilot license, needs no admin setup, and enhances interactive discussions without changing existing Interpreter features.

item.title: MC1220762: Retirement notice: MDE and XDR Advanced Hunting APIs retiring; migrate to Microsoft Graph Security API
item.description: Microsoft is retiring the Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting APIs by February 1, 2027. Organizations must manually migrate workflows to the Microsoft Graph Security API by January 31, 2027, to ensure continued functionality and improved security integration.

item.title: MC1523090: Microsoft Teams: Initiate side conversations within the meeting chat window
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow users to start or continue private side conversations within the meeting chat window, preserving chat history. This feature rolls out worldwide in January 2027, requires no admin action, and users can disable the side-chat tab if desired. No compliance issues identified.

item.title: MC1523087: Microsoft Teams Mobile: Ask Copilot from Search
item.description: Microsoft Teams mobile will let users ask Copilot directly from the search box on iOS and Android, with suggestions appearing after typing two words and an Ask Copilot button on search results. This feature rolls out worldwide from mid to late November 2026, requiring no admin action.

item.title: MC1523086: Alternate text parameter for ODSP attached images in Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams will support adding alt text to OneDrive/SharePoint-hosted images shared in chats, enhancing accessibility with screen reader descriptions. This feature rolls out worldwide from early to mid-December 2026, requires no admin action, and allows users to add or edit alt text without changing the original image files.

item.title: MC1523085: Viva Insights: GitHub Copilot metrics will be on by default, and the public preview opt-in setting is being retired
item.description: GitHub Copilot metrics will be enabled by default in the Viva Insights Consumption dashboard starting mid-November 2026, retiring the public preview opt-in setting. Eligible tenants will see these metrics automatically, with existing access controls remaining. No admin action is required, but reviewing access and updating documentation is recommended.

item.title: MC1523084: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Move email messages to quarantine with a new remediation action
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 introduces a new "Move to Quarantine" remediation action allowing admins to move suspicious emails from user mailboxes to Defender quarantine for safer investigation and management. It rolls out worldwide from November to December 2026, requiring no user action but recommended policy reviews and training updates.

item.title: MC1523077: Teams admin center - Intelligent insights for meeting quality
item.description: AI-powered meeting quality insights in Teams admin center provide proactive detection of issues by analyzing historical data, highlighting hotspots, root causes, and affected users with recommended actions. Rolling out worldwide and GCC from mid-November 2026. No configuration needed; accessible to designated Teams admins.

item.title: MC1523076: Microsoft Teams: Loop meeting notes stored in the meeting organizer's OneDrive
item.description: Non-channel Microsoft Teams meeting notes, including Loop and Facilitator notes, will be stored in the meeting organizer’s OneDrive for Business starting mid-November 2026. This ensures consistent ownership without changing the collaboration experience. No configuration is needed, but update governance processes accordingly. Channel meeting notes storage remains unchanged.

item.title: MC1482800: Teams Phone Agent is rolling out to general availability on Sept 30, 2026
item.description: Teams Phone Agent, an AI-powered calling solution for Microsoft Teams, will be generally available worldwide starting late September 2026. Usage-based billing with Copilot Credits requires admins to configure spending policies and security groups in the Microsoft 365 admin center to avoid default auto attendant settings.

item.title: MC1518030: Updated Photos experience on Windows 11
item.description: Windows 11 will receive an updated Photos app starting mid-October 2026, enhancing browsing, organizing, and viewing local and OneDrive photos. Existing app management and OneDrive policies remain effective. Organizations should review app-blocking rules and inform help desks; no new compliance issues are expected.

item.title: MC1456780: Plan for Change: New device page experience will become the default view
item.description: The new Intune device page will become the default view starting with the September (2609) release, replacing the legacy page. All device management features remain, but admins now need the Managed devices/Update permission plus specific action permissions. Update documentation and review permissions accordingly.

item.title: MC1454973: Manage Copilot connectors (Global setting) from Agent 365 - SetFederatedConnectors CLI toggle is retiring
item.description: The setFederatedConnectors CLI toggle for managing Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors is retiring by August 25, 2026. Connector governance will unify under the Allowed agent types setting in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Administrators should update workflows and review settings before October 30, 2026.

item.title: MC1521617: Microsoft OneDrive: Updated placement of the Create or upload button in OneDrive for the web
item.description: The OneDrive web experience is updated by moving the Create or upload button from the left navigation pane to the right side, aligning with SharePoint. It won't appear in Libraries, Recycle Bin, Meetings, or Media. Rollout starts late October 2026, no admin action needed.

item.title: MC1521616: Microsoft Graph APIs for Copilot cost management
item.description: Microsoft is introducing Microsoft Graph APIs for Copilot cost management, enabling programmatic control of credit spending policies, balance monitoring, and credit requests. Available in public preview from mid-October 2026 via the beta endpoint, these APIs integrate with existing admin and FinOps processes but exclude detailed consumption reporting. No action is needed if unused.

item.title: MC1521615: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management increases the auto-expanding archive limit from 1.5 TB to 3 TB
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management increases the auto-expanding archive limit for eligible Exchange Online mailboxes from 1.5 TB to 3 TB, starting mid-November 2026. No additional configuration or charges are required; organizations should review licenses and monitor mailbox growth accordingly.

item.title: MC1521614: Microsoft Teams: Retirement of the Turn off IntelliFrame option for online participants
item.description: Microsoft Teams will retire the "Turn off IntelliFrame" option for online participants in meetings with Teams Rooms using Cloud IntelliFrame. Starting late November 2026, all online users will see the room's IntelliFrame view. In-room users can still disable it. No admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1521613: Microsoft Teams: Streaming switchboard for NDI sources in meetings and events
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a streaming switchboard allowing event producers to select and stream up to eight NDI sources during meetings and events, starting November 2026. Admins must enable NDI streaming via policy, and users must activate production capabilities to use the feature.

item.title: MC1521609: Create sales pitches with Copilot in PowerPoint
item.description: Copilot in PowerPoint will help users create structured sales pitch presentations for various customer scenarios. Rolling out worldwide from mid to late October 2026 on Win32, Mac, and Web, it reduces manual work for sales teams. No admin action is required; informing users is recommended.

item.title: MC1521606: Create project kickoff presentations with Copilot in PowerPoint
item.description: Copilot in PowerPoint will help users create formal project kickoff presentations, aligning teams on goals, roles, milestones, and more. Rolling out worldwide mid to late October 2026 for PowerPoint on Win32, Mac, and Web. No admin action required; no compliance issues identified.

item.title: MC1521604: Microsoft Authenticator: Usability improvements for iOS and Android
item.description: Microsoft Authenticator will receive usability improvements on iOS and Android starting October 2026, including a refreshed home experience, clearer account restoration guidance, enhanced restoration flows, and platform-specific prompts. Android updates follow in November 2026 and January 2027. No action is required from organizations.

item.title: MC1483844: Microsoft Copilot: GPT 6.1 Sol and Claude Sonnet 5.5 beginning to roll out today
item.description: Microsoft Copilot is rolling out GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Sonnet 5.5 AI models starting September 30, 2026, across Cowork, Copilot Studio, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Chat. Usage-based billing applies, with limits and notifications. Access requires enabling Anthropic and OpenAI subprocessors and appropriate user licenses. No action required to enable.

item.title: MC920304: Microsoft Purview | Communication Compliance: Policy alerts improvements
item.description: Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance will enhance policy alert customization, allowing admins to set alert frequency and recipients per policy. Public preview rollout is delayed to October 2026. The feature is enabled by default and supports detecting compliance violations while ensuring user privacy.

item.title: MC1478965: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Retention for Copilot Memory
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management now supports retention of Microsoft 365 Copilot memory items, preserving historical versions for compliance and investigations. Retained inactive versions are stored in users' Exchange mailboxes, accessible via eDiscovery. Organizations should review retention policies and update governance accordingly. Rollout completed October 2026.

item.title: MC1455013: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management- Azure PST Import
item.description: Azure PST Import enables Microsoft 365 admins to import PST files from Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes using PowerShell. It includes readiness validation, reporting, and audit logging. The rollout starts late March 2027. Admins must prepare Azure storage, assign roles, and validate mailboxes before import.

item.title: MC1281505: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management- Azure PST Import
item.description: Azure PST Import enables Microsoft 365 admins to import PST files from Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes using PowerShell. The process includes readiness analysis, import execution, and reporting. Rollout begins mid-October 2026 (public preview) and late January 2027 (worldwide). It supports compliance via existing retention and audit tools.

item.title: MC791110: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management: New integration with Adaptive protection
item.description: Microsoft Purview is introducing a public preview of Adaptive protection integration with Data Lifecycle Management, automatically retaining deleted content from elevated risk users for 120 days. Rollout begins late June 2024, with general availability in late December 2026. Admins can enable this via the Purview compliance portal.

item.title: MC1520901: Insights Agent V2 Frontier
item.description: Insights Agent V2 is now available in Frontier, providing M365 admins tenant-level visibility into agent adoption and control over user feedback sharing. Feedback sharing is off by default and can be enabled in the Microsoft 365 admin center. No compliance issues identified. Public preview rollout is complete.

item.title: MC1519861: Outlook: Copilot Prioritize feature will be retired
item.description: The Copilot Prioritize feature in Outlook will be retired starting October 26, 2026, with removal completed by March 2027. It will be removed from all Outlook clients without requiring opt-in. No admin action is needed, but users should be notified and support materials updated accordingly.

item.title: MC1450126: Migrate your offline or signed-out devices to the Pro Management Portal for administration
item.description: Microsoft is transitioning Teams Android device management from the Teams admin center to the Teams Rooms Pro Management Portal by October 2026. Devices must run a supported Admin Agent version, updated automatically if online. Offline or outdated devices require manual updates to maintain management functionality. Administrators should verify updates and complete the transition steps promptly.

item.title: MC1480870: New SharePoint Mobile Experience on iOS and Android
item.description: The SharePoint mobile app for iOS and Android will roll out a redesigned home with a personalized Discover experience by late October to November 2026. It features improved site browsing, file previews, refreshed news, search, dark mode, and better performance, with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1309743: Viva Engage: Email updates for users without a routable mailbox
item.description: Starting mid-October 2026, Viva Engage will stop sending email notifications to users without valid mailboxes or routable email destinations, reducing email system load and improving delivery. Users with supported mailboxes and Teams notifications remain unaffected. No action is required, but review mailbox configurations and update support accordingly.

item.title: MC1450127: End-of-support Android devices may not be manageable through the Pro Management Portal
item.description: Microsoft is transitioning Teams Android device management from the Teams admin center to the Teams Rooms Pro Management Portal by October 2026. Supported devices will auto-update to a required Admin Agent version, while end-of-support devices may lose manageability. Administrators should verify device updates and readiness for PMP.

item.title: MC1509787: Microsoft Teams: Third-party synthetic audio and video detection in meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will support certified third-party synthetic audio and video detection in meetings starting mid-November 2026. Organizations can integrate these solutions to enhance security against AI-generated media threats. Admins must deploy provider apps, grant permissions, and configure meeting policies. Detection is performed by third parties, with Microsoft Teams enabling integration.

Users assigned the Dataverse Basic User security role will no longer be able to read solution custom connector definitions unless the connector is owned by that user or explicitly shared with them. item.title: MC1458484: Filter Messages by Events on Outlook Mobile
item.description: Outlook Mobile will add an "Events" filter to quickly find calendar invitations and event-related messages. Rolling out worldwide and in GCC environments from late August to late September 2026. No admin action needed; users can better manage meeting invites and RSVPs.

item.title: MC1519871: Copilot Code is rolling out in Frontier
item.description: Copilot Code, an AI-powered coding tool in Microsoft Copilot, is rolling out in the Frontier program starting late October 2026. It enables users with licenses and spending policies to build, refine, and publish apps using natural language, with admin-controlled usage-based billing and optional local coding on PC.

item.title: MC1519866: Microsoft Teams: Phishing detection for messaging
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce AI-powered, context-aware phishing detection starting November 2026, focusing on external first-contact chats and additional protection for mobile users in China. It identifies suspicious behavior without retaining message content, requires no admin action, and aims solely for security protection.

item.title: MC1519860: Intelligent Call Delegation in Teams
item.description: Intelligent Call Delegation in Teams uses AI to answer calls, gather context, and schedule follow-ups via Microsoft Bookings, helping users focus on important conversations. Rolling out from November 2026 (preview) to January 2027 (general availability), it requires appropriate licensing and admin configuration. No compliance issues identified.

item.title: MC1519857: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars on Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Teams Rooms on Android with Teams Rooms Pro license will gain access to a private presenter chat in green room-enabled meetings/events when joined as organizers. This backstage chat appears as "Event group" or "Planning group." Rollout starts August 2025 (preview) and completes November 2026 (general availability). No admin action needed.

item.title: MC1519856: Projects in Copilot
item.description: Projects in Copilot unify related chats, Cowork tasks, files, and context in one place, reducing repeated explanations. Available now in Cowork-tab (Windows, Mac, Web), with rollout to Chat and Cowork on Frontier soon. Files remain in OneDrive with existing permissions; no action or compliance concerns required.

item.title: MC1519855: Microsoft Entra: Choose your own telephony provider for SMS and voice authentication
item.description: Starting October 30, 2026, Microsoft Entra ID allows organizations to choose a supported third-party telephony provider for SMS and voice authentication via Microsoft Security Store. item.title: MC1519846: Microsoft 365 apps: Updated Brand Kit management experience
item.description: Microsoft 365 apps updated the Brand Kit management experience to simplify setup, streamline asset management, and improve workflows for Brand Managers. item.description: The new Outlook for Windows introduces an All Accounts view, a unified inbox showing emails from multiple accounts separately without merging. It supports AI-assisted workflows and search, rolling out globally by late October 2026. No admin action is needed now; controls will be available later.

item.title: MC1519842: Microsoft OneNote: JPG and PNG references in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Microsoft OneNote now supports using JPG and PNG images as knowledge sources in Copilot Notebooks, enabling Copilot to extract and use visual content for generating outputs. item.title: MC1519841: Microsoft OneNote: CSV and TSV references in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Microsoft OneNote now supports using CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources in Copilot Notebooks, enhancing content generation with structured data. item.description: Microsoft Publisher support ends October 1, 2026, and it will be removed from Microsoft 365 Apps via updates starting November 2026. item.title: MC1480869: Microsoft 365 settings enabled by default for newly created Engage communities
item.description: Newly created Microsoft Viva Engage communities will have Microsoft 365 group settings enabled by default, subscribing members to community emails and calendar invites. item.title: MC1519122: Microsoft Copilot: UBB models in Chat and Word, Excel, and PowerPoint via the model selector
item.description: Usage-based billing (UBB) models, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1, will be available in Microsoft Copilot Chat and Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint starting November 2026. Access requires enabling UBB, assigning credits, and a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. Admins manage billing and credit allocation.

item.description: We are announcing the enhancement to improve support for building Copilot Chat agents, also known as declarative agents, that provide authoritative answers and standardized content in Copilot Studio. item.description: We are enhancing the Evaluations experience to help makers better understand agent quality and behavior in Microsoft Copilot Studio. This feature is now available. item.description: We are announcing the public preview of admin controls for managing Business Applications in Work IQ. item.title: MC1518034: Clipchamp/ Copilot 'Create a video' experience is going to have an admin control available
item.description: Microsoft Clipchamp will add an admin policy control to manage user access to the AI-powered "Create a video" feature, rolling out worldwide from late November to early December 2026. Admins can enable or restrict this feature via Microsoft 365 admin center policies. No user action is needed if access is allowed.

item.title: MC1518033: Microsoft Teams: Onboarding workflow for new team members
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce an onboarding workflow to automatically connect new members to relevant channels, improving engagement and onboarding speed. Rollout starts November 2026 (Targeted Release) and completes by mid-December 2026 (General Availability). No admin action is needed; inform team owners accordingly.

item.title: MC1518032: Microsoft 365 apps: Introducing Update Repair in Inventory
item.description: Update Repair in Inventory helps admins identify and fix Windows devices with outdated or problematic Microsoft 365 apps via the admin center. It enables remote Online Repair for eligible devices, rolling out from October to November 2026. Admins must enable Inventory and notify users before repairs.

item.title: MC1266912: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Intelligent Summaries in Copilot Dashboard
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Dashboard will automatically provide AI-generated intelligent summaries starting November 2026, highlighting adoption trends and usage insights for admins. No configuration is needed, existing permissions remain, and there is no user impact. Organizations can notify teams or update documentation if desired.

item.description: We are announcing the ability to store multiple lines of text as prompt column output to enable makers to save longer and more detailed AI-generated insights in Dataverse tables. item.title: MC1477187: Microsoft OneDrive: OneDrive sync supports up to 1 million items on macOS
item.description: OneDrive sync on macOS will increase its item limit from 300,000 to 1 million per device, starting with a Public Preview in mid-October 2026 for Insiders ring users. Devices not meeting hardware requirements will remain at the current limit, with no disruption expected.

item.title: MC1515940: Microsoft OneDrive: Copilot actions in the File Explorer context menu are being retired
item.description: Microsoft is retiring several OneDrive Copilot actions from the File Explorer context menu by early December 2026, simplifying usage. Users can still access Copilot features via right-click "Ask Copilot," the File Explorer Home icon, or the OneDrive activity center. No admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1457226: Microsoft OneDrive: Refreshed file browsing and filtering experience in OneDrive Web
item.description: OneDrive for the web will adopt the modern SharePoint document library experience, featuring improved navigation and enhanced filtering across views. Rollout begins mid-August 2026, completing by late October. Changes are enabled by default, with no impact on permissions or policies; no user action required.

item.title: MC1288531: Microsoft Viva - Copilot Analytics: Export agent data from the Agent Dashboard
item.description: Microsoft Viva will add a new export feature in the Agent Dashboard by mid-November 2026, allowing eligible users with at least 50 Copilot licenses to download de-identified Copilot agent usage data for up to six months. Admins can manage or disable this feature via Viva Feature Access Management.

item.title: MC1479503: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps: Permission changes for select App Governance Entra roles
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps will update App Governance permissions for select Microsoft Entra roles starting mid-November 2026. Changes include role-based access control alignment with Defender XDR, affecting Cloud App Security, Compliance Administrator, and Compliance Data Administrator roles. Admins should review and update role assignments accordingly.

item.title: MC1446796: Migrate Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing before EWS deprecation
item.description: Exchange Web Services (EWS) deprecation starts October 1, 2026, affecting cross-tenant Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing. Microsoft 365 Cross-Tenant Access Policy will replace EWS by October 2026. Organizations must migrate to avoid service disruption; Gov rollout is paused. Hybrid/on-premises scenarios are excluded.

item.title: MC1461165: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator can join channel meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow adding Facilitator to channel meetings starting early February 2027, enabling note-taking, agenda management, Q&A, and task management. The rollout is delayed from November 2026, requires no action, and affects organizations with Facilitator enabled and licensed users.

item.description: We are announcing the ability to allow representatives to set next presence to indicate their future availability in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. item.description: Sending from Aliases is now generally available in Exchange Online, allowing users to send emails from any mailbox alias. Admins can enable it via PowerShell or Exchange Admin Center. Additional features are being explored, and no compliance issues have been identified.

item.title: MC1515937: Microsoft Purview | eDiscovery: In-product diagnostics to troubleshoot common challenges
item.description: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery introduces three read-only diagnostics for case access, security filters, and hold-policy distribution to help admins troubleshoot issues. Rolling out from October 2026 to February 2027 across environments. No admin action required; diagnostics do not alter configurations.

item.title: MC1515932: External Recipients Banner on Outlook Mobile
item.description: Outlook Mobile will display a banner warning when external attendees are added to meetings, rolling out worldwide from late October to late November 2026. This helps prevent accidental sharing with external recipients. No action or compliance changes are required.

item.title: MC1515931: Microsoft Teams: Simplified app enablement experience in Teams admin center
item.description: Microsoft is launching a simplified app enablement experience in the Teams admin center by mid-October 2026. It offers a guided flow for managing app access, installation, and permissions, reducing steps for admins. Existing settings remain unchanged until admins apply updates. No prior action is needed.

item.title: MC1515930: Cowork browser use setting renamed to Browser use in Microsoft Copilot
item.description: The Cowork settings panel in Microsoft Copilot is renamed to Browser use in Microsoft Copilot to improve discoverability. This change, rolling out in mid-October 2026, does not affect functionality or configurations. No action is required; admins will find the setting under the new name.

item.title: MC1515929: Microsoft Teams: GitHub app consolidation and legacy GitHub app deprecation
item.description: Microsoft Teams is consolidating GitHub Notifications and GitHub Copilot into a single GitHub app, deprecating the legacy app by November 16, 2026. Users must update or replace the old apps with the new GitHub app, which integrates repository updates and Copilot features. Admins should manage app access and update policies accordingly.

item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot's Critique and Council preview experiences in Researcher will retire between late October and mid-November 2026. No compliance issues noted.

item.title: MC1515917: Database Hub in Fabric: Default enablement and admin opt-out
item.description: Microsoft Fabric will enable Database Hub by default on November 17, 2026, allowing authorized users to access database insights without admin activation. Admins can opt out via the Fabric admin portal. No databases or permissions change, and usage remains subject to existing roles and licensing.

item.title: MC1469565: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Graph API Support for archive mailboxes
item.description: Microsoft is retiring Exchange Web Services (EWS) in Exchange Online by April 2027 and expanding Microsoft Graph API support for archive mailboxes. Organizations must migrate applications from EWS to Microsoft Graph APIs by October 2026 to maintain archive mailbox access, compliance, eDiscovery, and data lifecycle management.

item.title: MC1302905: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Purview SDK embedded in Agent Framework SDK
item.description: Microsoft has paused the rollout of integrating the Microsoft Purview SDK into the Agent Framework SDK, which enables AI agents to enforce Purview compliance and data protection. This integration requires developer implementation and affects organizations building AI agents with Purview licenses. No immediate admin action is needed if not developing AI agents.

item.title: MC1472601: Microsoft Purview: Archive SharePoint files under retention policies
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will allow admins to archive inactive SharePoint files under retention policies starting early December 2026. Archived files move to Microsoft 365 Archive, remain compliant and discoverable, and are excluded from Copilot indexing to improve response relevance. This feature requires admin configuration.

item.title: MC1443518: Microsoft Teams: Expanded presenter visibility in Manage what attendees see
item.description: Microsoft Teams is enhancing presenter visibility in "Manage what attendees see" by allowing event organizers and producers to drag and resize the presenter panel, displaying more presenters simultaneously. This update, rolling out from mid-August to October 2026, improves event production efficiency without requiring admin action.

item.title: MC1443517: Microsoft Teams: External presenters can manage event production controls
item.description: Microsoft Teams now allows event organizers to grant production control permissions to trusted external presenters, including federated (B2B) and guest users, enabling them to manage event production controls. This feature, rolling out August–November 2026, enhances collaboration with external partners without automatic changes to existing events.

item.title: MC1330891: Microsoft Teams: Breakout rooms now supported in meetings with up to 1,000 attendees
item.description: Microsoft Teams now supports breakout rooms in meetings with up to 1,000 attendees, allowing up to 100 breakout rooms per meeting. Rollout begins July 2026, with general availability by October 2026. The feature is enabled by default, requires no action, and maintains the existing experience for smaller meetings.

item.title: MC1266027: Microsoft Teams: New experience when users minimize the meeting window
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new minimized meeting experience by late October 2026, allowing users to raise hands and send reactions without reopening the full window. Two minimized views—expanded (shows up to four videos) and compact (no videos)—are enabled by default, with no impact on screen sharing.

item.title: MC1307982: Microsoft Teams Town halls: Upload custom backgrounds in Manage what attendees see
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow organizers and presenters of town hall events with Teams Premium licenses to upload custom background images in the "Manage what attendees see" feature. Rollout begins early June 2026, enabling branded visuals behind presenters and shared content in supported layouts. No admin action required.

item.title: MC1473153: Microsoft Teams: New centralized experience for organizing important resources in chats and channels
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a centralized resource management experience in chats and channels, allowing users to pin and organize resources below headers and access them on mobile. The "In this chat" and "In this channel" panes will be removed. Rollout occurs from late September to mid-November 2026.

item.title: MC1325441: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Archive SharePoint files under retention
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will enable archiving SharePoint files based on retention policies, moving inactive content to Microsoft 365 Archive to reduce storage costs while maintaining compliance and discoverability. Archived content is excluded from Copilot indexing. Rollout begins September 2026; admin configuration is required.

item.title: MC1388719: Microsoft Teams: Granular channel notification settings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce granular channel notification presets—All new messages, Mentions and replies, and Mute—with further customization options. Rollout occurs from October to December 2026 across environments. The feature is enabled by default, requires no admin changes, and aims to improve notification control and reduce noise.

item.title: MC1506727: Microsoft Agent 365: Expanded access to Microsoft agent usage and activity insights in Microsoft 365 admin center
item.description: Starting late October 2026, Microsoft 365 admin center will expand access to usage and activity insights for Microsoft-built or platform-based agents, regardless of Agent 365 licensing. This provides foundational visibility into agent metrics, while full management features still require paid licenses. Rollout completes by late November 2026.

item.title: MC1404326: Microsoft 365 admin center: New usage report for Copilot connectors
item.description: Microsoft 365 will introduce a new Copilot connectors usage report in the admin center by November 2026, showing usage across Copilot Chat, Search, and agents. It requires a Copilot (Premium) license, is enabled by default, and helps admins track adoption without impacting user workflows.

item.title: MC1193692: Microsoft 365: Enrich profile cards with custom properties from third-party systems
item.description: Starting November 2026, Microsoft 365 admins can add up to 10 custom properties from external systems to user profile cards via Microsoft Graph People connectors. This feature is off by default, requires configuration, and enhances profile information in Outlook Web to improve collaboration context.

item.title: MC1411727: Copilot Notebooks: Suggested artifacts for faster content creation
item.description: Copilot Notebooks will proactively suggest relevant Word, Excel, and PowerPoint artifacts based on notebook content and Microsoft 365 context, speeding content creation. Available by default to eligible users from early July 2026 (preview) and late August 2026 (general availability). No admin action required; future support for PDFs and Pages planned.

item.title: MC1511072: Microsoft Teams: Upcoming change to voicemail message delivery by email
item.description: Microsoft Teams will change voicemail email delivery by early March 2027, moving caller info from the email From field to the Subject line and allowing organizations to use their own domains for sending. Organizations should update mail-flow rules accordingly; no new compliance requirements arise.

item.title: MC1511071: Action required: Review property changes for Exchange Online scenarios
item.description: Exchange Online is deprecating certain properties in Get-Mailbox -Migration and New-Mailbox -Migration cmdlets starting November 15, 2026. Organizations must review and update scripts or workflows using these properties before then to avoid disruptions. Full details and guidance are provided in the linked Microsoft documentation.

item.title: MC1511056: Microsoft Copilot Studio – Teams app retirement
item.description: Microsoft is retiring the Copilot Studio app in Teams by February 2027, transitioning all chatbot agent creation and management to the Copilot Studio web app. Editing in Teams ends January 2027. Users and admins should switch to the web app and update related documentation accordingly.

item.title: MC1511052: Upcoming changes to Agents in SharePoint and OneDrive
item.description: SharePoint and OneDrive agents using the .agent file format will be upgraded to integrate with Microsoft Copilot’s extensibility ecosystem. From mid-November 2026, new agents use the Copilot Agent Builder, with .agent files supported until March 2027, after which they stop working. Organizations should prepare to upgrade agents and adopt new management and governance tools.

item.title: MC1009930: Microsoft Teams: Distinguish invites among Attendee, Presenter, and Co-organizer emails
item.description: Microsoft Teams will send separate event invites for Attendees, Presenters, and Co-organizers, helping organizers manage town hall invites distinctly. item.title: MC1509805: Microsoft Copilot: Additional content safety protections for students under 18
item.description: Microsoft Copilot will automatically enable additional content safety protections for users aged 13-17, identified by the teen ageGroup in Entra ID, starting mid-October 2026. item.title: MC1509803: Microsoft PowerPoint: Publish and unpublish controls for official brand kits
item.description: Microsoft PowerPoint will introduce publish and unpublish controls for Official Brand Kits in mid-October 2026, allowing Brand Managers to temporarily remove or restore brand assets without deleting them or changing permissions, enhancing brand content management and availability within organizations. No action is required.

item.title: MC1509801: Microsoft Teams: Customize file extensions blocked by Weaponizable File Protection
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow admins to customize file extensions blocked by Weaponizable File Protection starting November 2026. item.title: MC1509800: Microsoft Outlook for Android: Multi-select and bulk actions in search results
item.description: Microsoft Outlook for Android will add multi-select and bulk actions in search results starting mid-October 2026, allowing users to manage multiple emails at once. This feature, already on iOS, improves efficiency without requiring admin action; users should be informed and keep the app updated.

item.title: MC1509799: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Legal plugins in Word and Cowork
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces legal plugins in Word and Cowork to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline documents using Microsoft 365 context and third-party sources. Rollout occurs from April to December 2026. Admins can enable or disable these plugins; no setup is required.

item.title: MC1509797: Support for Office LTSC 2021 and additional apps ended on October 13, 2026
item.description: Support for Office LTSC 2021 and related apps ended on October 13, 2026, with no more security updates or support. Organizations should upgrade to Microsoft 365 Apps or Office LTSC 2024 to maintain security, compliance, and support. Admins must identify and update affected devices promptly.

item.title: MC1509796: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced channel meeting experience
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enhance channel meetings, allowing scheduling from Teams calendar and Outlook, easier discovery for channel members, and delegate scheduling. Rollout starts November 2026, completing by September 2027 across environments. No admin action needed; informing users is recommended. No compliance issues identified.

item.title: MC1509789: Microsoft Edge: Browser-native XSLT will be disabled by default
item.description: Microsoft Edge will disable browser-native XSLT by default starting mid-December 2026 to reduce security risks. Organizations should identify and migrate affected applications before Edge Stable 159. A temporary XSLTEnabled policy will be available but removed by Edge 176 in Summer 2027.

item.title: MC1509780: Intune ending support for Windows MDM-only enrollment CNAME auto-discovery
item.description: Starting January 15, 2027, Intune will end support for DNS CNAME auto-discovery in Windows MDM-only enrollment. Organizations using this must have users manually enter the Microsoft enrollment server URL. Existing devices and other enrollment methods remain unaffected. Update enrollment procedures accordingly.

item.title: MC1187781: Viva Engage: Community feeds improvements
item.description: Viva Engage communities will default to viewing conversations by recent posts instead of recent activity starting October 2026. Users can still choose their preferred feed and sort order, with settings saved across communities. Unread indicators will appear in both new and all feeds. No action required.

item.title: MC1419798: Microsoft Teams Rooms: Identify in-room participants with IntelliFrame people labels
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will introduce IntelliFrame people labels by late January 2027, automatically displaying enrolled in-room participants’ names and contact cards to remote attendees, enhancing hybrid meeting clarity. The feature requires Teams Rooms Pro licenses, voice and face recognition enrollment, and can be managed via Teams meeting policies.

item.title: MC1474110: Microsoft Planner: Capacity view
item.description: Microsoft Planner's new Capacity view, launching late October 2026, shows a live staffing timeline from existing task data for Plan 3 licensed users on web and desktop (Teams, Outlook). It helps spot workload distribution without extra reports. No admin action needed; users should keep task details updated.

item.title: MC1443514: Microsoft Planner: Planner Agent chat in basic plans
item.description: Planner Agent chat is being added to Microsoft Planner basic plans, enabling users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license to interact via natural language for plan management, insights, and task updates. Rollout begins September 2026, with admin controls to enable or block access.

item.title: MC1506734: Microsoft Teams: Video sharing from OneDrive in Teams events
item.description: Microsoft Teams will soon allow event organizers and producers to share videos directly from OneDrive during Teams events using "Manage what attendees see," enabling smoother, higher-quality playback without screen sharing. Rollout begins November 2026; no action is required, but informing organizers and updating guidance is recommended.

item.title: MC1387578: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Localized default mark and notify email template
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will localize the default "Mark and notify" email template based on users' Outlook language settings, improving clarity in user-reported message notifications. Rollout starts June 2026 globally, with no changes to message classification or custom templates. No action is required.

item.title: MC1155311: Viva Engage: Agents in Viva Engage communities Public Preview
item.description: Viva Engage Community Agents are in public preview, allowing admins to add AI agents that draft answers using community and selected SharePoint content. Features include tagging by members, analytics, and configurable posting modes. General availability and network-wide settings will be announced later; admins can opt in via the Engage admin center.

item.title: MC1462921: Calls popout into a new window on the browser to support multi-tasking and collaboration during a meeting
item.description: Microsoft Teams for Web will introduce a Picture-in-Picture Call Monitor allowing users to manage meetings in a separate window while multitasking in other browser tabs. The rollout starts mid-October 2026 for supported browsers like Edge and Chrome, requiring no admin action but user awareness and supported browser versions.

item.title: MC1409304: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator proactively detects and resolves knowledge gaps in meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams introduces Facilitator, an AI feature that detects and resolves knowledge gaps in meetings by providing relevant answers via web search in the chat. Available from December 2026, it requires Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) and must be manually enabled. Admin controls and user opt-out are supported.

item.title: MC1479514: Microsoft Teams: Improved file sharing experience in external chats
item.description: Microsoft Teams is enabling default file attachment (paperclip and drag-and-drop) in external chats, storing files in the sender’s OneDrive with automatic permission assignment per existing OneDrive/SharePoint policies. Organizations can opt out via Teams PowerShell. Existing sharing restrictions remain unchanged. User training and policy review are recommended.

item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce two new chat sections—Muted chats (enabled by default) and Meeting chats (disabled by default)—to organize conversations. item.description: Microsoft is introducing a default-on public preview of a data export feature in the Copilot Dashboard for users with full company-level access. It enables export of de-identified, weekly Copilot usage metrics from the past six months to analyze adoption and optimize licensing. Requires 50+ Copilot licenses.

item.title: MC1508992: Power Platform – Deprecation of temporary authentication URLs for the Word Online (Business) connector
item.description: On October 14, 2026, the Word Online (Business) connector will remove its dependency on temporary, pre-authorized download URLs. item.description: Beginning with the October 2026 security update, Windows 11, versions 26H2, 25H2, and 24H2, along with Windows Server 2025 enforce restrictions on generating NTLMv1-derived credentials for Single Sign-On by default. item.title: MC1508238: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection: Sensitivity labels for Microsoft Entra security groups
item.description: Microsoft Purview will enable sensitivity labels for Microsoft Entra cloud security groups starting mid-November 2026, allowing administrators to apply and enforce governance policies on these groups. Labels can be assigned via multiple platforms, cannot yet be changed once applied, and require separate tenant configuration from Microsoft 365 groups.

item.title: MC1508235: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Count of labeled documents condition for Exchange Online
item.description: Microsoft Purview DLP introduces a new Exchange Online condition to detect emails with a high count of sensitivity-labeled attachments, enhancing data protection. Available from November 2026, it allows admins to set thresholds for labeled files in emails, combining volume and content signals for better DLP policy enforcement.

item.title: MC1508234: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription options align with admin policies
item.description: Microsoft Teams will update meeting options to show only automatic recording and transcription settings allowed by assigned policies, adding a new "Record only" option. item.title: MC1302906: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Schedule prompts in Agent Builder
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot’s Agent Builder will support scheduled workflows to run prompts automatically on hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly cadences. Available worldwide by November 2026, this feature enables users to automate routine tasks per user, with workflows editable and enabled by default.

item.title: MC1506735: Microsoft Planner: AI-generated status reports in Planner Agent
item.description: Microsoft Planner now includes AI-generated status reports via Planner Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, summarizing plan progress, risks, and next steps. Users with a Copilot license can customize and generate reports from accessible plan data. Rollout starts late October 2026, with no required user action.

item.description: Starting November 4, 2026, default users in Microsoft Entra can create agent blueprints unless administrators disable this via the "Users can create agent blueprints" setting. Admins can restrict this by toggling the setting to No in the Entra admin center before rollout completes in late November.

item.title: MC1506730: Classic Outlook for Windows: Upcoming visual improvements and a more consistent Outlook experience
item.description: Classic Outlook for Windows will receive visual updates like improved icons, spacing, and alignment starting early November 2026, enhancing clarity and consistency without changing workflows. No admin action is needed; users and help desks should be informed of appearance changes. These updates do not replace the classic experience.

item.title: MC1506728: Microsoft Entra: Changes to AgentIdentity.CreateAsManager permission for agent identities
item.description: Starting November 4, Microsoft Entra will stop automatically granting the AgentIdentity.CreateAsManager permission to agent blueprints. Admin consent will be required for agents to create identities. This change, rolling out worldwide in November 2026, enhances control and auditability of agent identity creation.

item.title: MC1440972: Microsoft Edge: Upgraded Copilot new tab page
item.description: Microsoft Edge is upgrading the Copilot new tab page to integrate Microsoft 365 Copilot chat, web search, and work content in one experience with enhanced chat, compose features, suggested actions, and a refreshed design. Rollout begins late September 2026, requiring a Copilot license and admin enablement.

item.title: MC1381121: Microsoft Purview | Endpoint Data Loss Prevention: Policy sync and device health AI skill
item.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint Data Loss Prevention will introduce AI-powered policy sync and device health insights to improve troubleshooting and policy enforcement visibility. The rollout is paused; no immediate action is needed. The feature requires Security Copilot and enhances compliance monitoring with AI-driven root cause analysis and remediation recommendations.

item.description: Microsoft Copilot Studio and Copilot Cowork preview app-building with natural-language AI, enabling makers to create, test, and publish apps using organizational data and policies. Copilot Credits manage usage and billing. Admins control access and governance via the Microsoft 365 admin center. Rollout started September 2026.

item.title: MC999442: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management: Retention based on “last accessed” for OneDrive and SharePoint files
item.description: Microsoft Purview will enable retention policies based on the "last accessed" date for Office files in OneDrive and SharePoint, starting preview in January 2027 and general availability by March 2027. This helps delete obsolete data and improve Microsoft 365 Copilot responses, with no admin action required before rollout.

item.title: MC1484010: Microsoft Teams: Hide organizer names in calendar view on Teams Panels
item.description: Microsoft Teams Panels will add an admin setting to show or hide organizer names in Calendar View, configurable via the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal or panel device. This feature, available with Teams Rooms Pro and Shared Spaces licenses, launches worldwide in early October 2026.

item.title: MC1437671: Microsoft Entra: Allow password change after secure sign-in with My Sign-Ins
item.description: Microsoft Entra will enable users to change passwords after secure sign-in using strong credentials (passkey, FIDO2, Windows Hello) without knowing the current password or using SSPR. This feature, disabled by default, requires admin activation and will roll out globally from October to November 2026.

item.title: MC1505610: Public CDN is becoming optional during Brand Center setup
item.description: Brand Center setup will no longer require enabling Public CDN by default, allowing organizations to use branding governance without it. Public CDN remains necessary for font features and must be explicitly enabled. This change rolls out worldwide in October 2026 with no action required unless fonts are used.

item.title: MC1505609: Microsoft 365 Copilot and Power Apps: Retirement of App Builder agent and vibe.powerapps.com
item.description: Microsoft is retiring the App Builder agent and vibe.powerapps.com by November 30, 2026, consolidating app creation into Copilot Cowork and Microsoft Copilot Studio. New app creation in retired platforms ends mid-October 2026. Organizations must migrate existing apps before retirement using upcoming in-product migration tools.

item.title: MC1505608: Audio overviews on PDF
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app's Audio Overviews on PDFs, which create AI-generated podcast-style summaries for commercial users, will be retired worldwide on October 30, 2026. After this date, the feature and previously generated audio overviews will no longer be available. No admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1505599: Microsoft Purview Audit: AuditLogQuery API generally available and Search-UnifiedAuditLog retiring
item.description: The Microsoft Graph AuditLogQuery API will be generally available in October 2026, replacing the Search-UnifiedAuditLog PowerShell cmdlet, which will retire on October 15, 2027. Organizations using Search-UnifiedAuditLog must migrate to the API to avoid disruptions, as future audit search enhancements will focus on the API.

item.title: MC1429018: Microsoft Teams: Meeting memory file generation
item.description: Microsoft Teams will generate AI meeting memory files capturing key meeting insights to enhance Microsoft 365 Copilot and Facilitator responses. These files, stored securely in tenant-owned SharePoint, are enabled by default with admin controls and configurable retention. Rollout starts November 2026, requiring no immediate action but admin review.

item.title: MC1479277: Microsoft Copilot: New ways to work across Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft 365
item.description: Microsoft Copilot updates include a new Home experience, enhanced Office integration, Code and Autopilot features with usage-based billing, Copilot Managed Runtime for enterprise code, and general availability in SharePoint and OneDrive. Admins must configure spending policies and manage access via the Microsoft 365 admin center.

item.title: MC1182703: Microsoft Teams: Channel agent orchestration with GitHub, Asana, and Jira via Model Context Protocol (MCP)
item.description: Microsoft Teams' Channel Agent integration with GitHub, Asana, and Jira via Model Context Protocol (MCP) rollout is paused. This feature enables task orchestration across tools within Teams, requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, and will be previewed with admin enablement when resumed.

item.description: Starting November 1, 2026, Dynamics 365 Sales Insights as a standalone add-on will have reached end of support. item.title: MC1387526: Microsoft 365 Backup: Full workload backup for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange
item.description: Microsoft 365 Backup introduces Full Workload Backup for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange, enabling admins to protect entire workloads with one policy. It automatically covers all existing and new artifacts, reduces admin effort, and supports enterprise data protection. Rollout begins July 2026; admin configuration is required to enable.

item.title: MC1392571: Connect Teams meeting to existing Planner Plans
item.description: Microsoft Teams meetings can now be linked to existing Microsoft Planner plans, allowing tasks to be tracked in one place instead of multiple plans. This feature, rolling out late December 2026 to January 2027, is enabled by default and supports automated or manual task creation via Facilitator.

item.title: MC796790: Unified management of app and agent availability and installation in Teams, Outlook, and the Microsoft 365 app
item.description: Microsoft is unifying app and agent availability and installation management across Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 admin centers. Availability unification began in September 2025 in phases, with automatic unification planned. Installation unification starts late September 2026, synchronizing settings without admin action for eligible tenants.

item.title: MC1493223: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Skills in Copilot Chat
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat now supports customizable skills for task-specific instructions, usable by end users and deployable by admins. Skills integrate with plugins, are discoverable in the Agent Store, and work across Copilot Chat and Cowork. Rollout begins October 2026, with Information Barriers support in November.

item.title: MC1493186: Microsoft Outlook for Android and iOS: Send Availability functionality restored
item.description: The Send Availability feature is restored in Microsoft Outlook for Android and iOS, allowing users to share their meeting availability easily while composing emails. iOS users can also access it via the keyboard and VoiceOver. The update is available worldwide with no action required.

item.title: MC1492958: Microsoft Graph: New tenant controls for retirement of non-standard file API tokens
item.description: Microsoft will retire pre-authenticated (tempauth) URLs in SharePoint Online and OneDrive by April 1, 2027. New tenant controls will allow admins to test updated Microsoft Graph URL behavior using Microsoft Entra ID authentication. Apps must stop relying on embedded auth URLs and HTTP 302 redirects. Validation before the deadline is recommended.

item.title: MC1492955: Microsoft Planner: Introducing Local Custom Fields
item.description: Microsoft Planner introduces Local Custom Fields, allowing users with Planner Premium licenses to add up to 10 customizable fields (Text, Number, Date, Yes/No, Choice) to tasks for tailored workflows. Microsoft 365 users have read-only access. The rollout begins late October 2026, with no admin setup required. Custom fields integrate with existing compliance and audit features.

item.title: MC1492954: Microsoft Outlook: Themes by Copilot retirement
item.description: Themes by Copilot in Microsoft Outlook will be retired worldwide from mid- to late October 2026. Users with a Copilot license will lose the ability to select or revert to these themes, though current themes remain until changed. No action is required.

item.title: MC1462473: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live introduces light mode for presenters
item.description: PowerPoint Live in Microsoft Teams will add a light mode option for presenters, alongside dark, classic, and high contrast modes. This update, rolling out from September to November 2026, enhances flexibility and accessibility without affecting presentation content or attendee views. No admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1492165: Microsoft PowerPoint for Windows: Improved slide contextual menu consistency
item.description: Microsoft PowerPoint for Windows will update the slide contextual menu for better consistency and organization, removing the low-usage Photo Album command from the menu but keeping it in the Insert tab. item.title: MC1492164: Microsoft PowerPoint for Mac: Improved slide contextual menu consistency
item.description: Microsoft PowerPoint for Mac will update slide contextual menus for consistency, removing the Zoom command and Cut/Copy from the slide menu but keeping them elsewhere. Layout and Reset Slide commands will appear in both slide and thumbnail menus. The change rolls out worldwide in October 2026, enabled by default with no impact on compliance or licensing.

item.title: MC1492163: Microsoft API Hub: Zendesk OAuth tokens will require expiration and automatic refresh
item.description: Microsoft API Hub will update Zendesk OAuth tokens to expire after 48 hours with refresh tokens expiring after 90 days, supporting automatic refresh. Existing connections must be reauthorized by early 2027 to avoid failures. Organizations should identify and reauthorize affected connections and inform developers.

item.title: MC1492161: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint: 'Clarify my thinking' skill for desktop
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint on desktop introduces the "Clarify my thinking" skill, helping users refine ideas and improve presentations. item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint on web introduces the "Clarify my thinking" skill, helping users refine ideas and improve presentations. item.title: MC1492155: Microsoft PowerPoint for Mac: Smarter Keep Source Formatting slide pasting experience
item.description: PowerPoint for Mac now imports only necessary slide masters and layouts when pasting slides with Keep Source Formatting, reducing file size and improving performance and collaboration. item.description: Microsoft is launching new Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service experiences integrated with Teams, Copilot, and Outlook, enabling seamless access to customer data and workflows. item.description: Starting September 2026, Microsoft will redirect users from m365.cloud.microsoft to copilot.cloud.microsoft. Organizations must allow connections to *.cloud.microsoft in network and security controls to avoid Copilot access disruptions. Validate connectivity, update allow lists, and coordinate with security teams before the redirect.

item.title: MC1449182: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot Pages and Notebooks Creation in OneDrive
item.description: Starting mid-October 2026, new Microsoft 365 Copilot Pages and Notebooks will be stored in OneDrive for Business, enabling existing OneDrive governance, compliance, data protection, retention, and lifecycle management features to apply. Existing Copilot content remains unchanged; no user action is required.
