item.title: MC1459133: Microsoft Entra ID: Passkey support for B2B users
item.description: Microsoft Entra ID will support passkey registration and sign-in for B2B users, enabling phishing-resistant MFA in resource tenants starting late October 2026. Internal guest users get Microsoft Authenticator app passkeys; external users do not. The feature is enabled by default, intersecting with SMS/voice retirement policies. No action required, but administrators should review policies.

item.title: MC1465780: Outlook for iOS and Android: Automatically apply email sensitivity labels from labeled attachments
item.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will automatically apply or recommend email sensitivity labels based on attached files with Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels starting mid-November 2026. This enhances consistent data protection, reduces manual labeling, and supports compliance without requiring admin action. Organizations should review label policies accordingly.

item.title: MC1461152: Create interactive slides in PowerPoint with Copilot skill (Windows and Mac)
item.description: PowerPoint's new Copilot skill "Create interactive slide" enables users on Windows, Mac, and web to easily create interactive, full-slide visuals for complex concepts, timelines, and data. Attendees can interact independently in PowerPoint Live for Teams. Rollout begins mid-October 2026; a Copilot license is required.

item.title: MC1490912: Microsoft Teams: Call quality feedback surveys for Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce call quality feedback surveys for Teams Rooms on Android starting November 2026. Users can rate audio, video, and screen-sharing quality after meetings. Feedback helps improve Teams services. No admin action is required before rollout; updating the app and informing users is recommended.

item.title: MC1490911: Microsoft Edge: Retiring legacy sign-in implementation on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Edge on Windows will retire its legacy direct-WAM sign-in in version 157, fully adopting the OneAuth library to standardize authentication. Rollout starts and completes in November 2026. Admins should identify unmigrated profiles, test transitions, and prepare for possible user sign-in prompts.

item.title: MC1490909: Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management: Private preview for selected developer package vulnerability coverage
item.description: Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management is privately previewing expanded vulnerability coverage for selected Node.js, Python, and Java packages on Windows devices. It integrates with existing workflows, APIs, and exports, with rollout planned from September to December 2026. Organizations should prepare for increased data volume and validate integrations before enabling.

item.title: MC1490908: Education Insights for Reading Progress: Challenge Assignments retirement
item.description: The Challenge Assignments feature in Education Insights for Reading Progress will retire on December 31, 2026. Educators can still create follow-up assignments based on challenging words directly in Reading Progress. Phonics rule-based assignments will be discontinued. No data will be deleted, and no admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1490906: Microsoft Teams: Analytics for desk utilization in Teams Pro Management portal
item.description: Microsoft Teams Pro Management portal will add desk utilization analytics, showing usage, reservations, occupancy, and peak patterns. Requires desks with peripheral devices and appropriate Shared Space licenses. Rolling out worldwide from November to mid-December 2026 to aid space planning without compliance concerns.

item.title: MC1490905: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Post-delivery protection for malicious QR codes in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 extends Teams URL protection to detect malicious URLs in QR codes post-delivery, warning users and enabling security teams to investigate via Advanced Hunting. Rolling out worldwide from October to November 2026, no user action is required, but admins should review related settings and processes.

item.title: MC1490903: 'Record A Skill' Capability in PowerPoint Copilot
item.description: PowerPoint Copilot will introduce a "Record a Skill" feature in October 2026, allowing users to record and reuse workflows for common tasks. This enhances efficiency and consistency without requiring admin action. Organizations should inform support teams and users about this new capability.

item.title: MC1490899: Microsoft 365: Targeted Release retirement
item.description: Microsoft 365 Targeted Release will retire in January 2027, replaced by Frontier, Standard, and Deferred release options. Administrators must update user enrollments and release preferences by November 2026, when Targeted Release management ends and a unified release preferences experience launches in the admin center.

item.title: MC1454378: Microsoft 365: The Next Generation of File & Folder Sharing
item.description: Microsoft 365 introduces a third-generation sharing experience with a single "hero link" for files and folders, simplifying access control and updates. Rolling out worldwide from October to November 2026, it affects SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft 365 sharing, with no required user action before rollout.

item.title: MC1448373: Teams device management begins transitioning from Teams admin center to Teams Rooms Pro management portal
item.description: Teams device management is transitioning from Teams Admin Center (TAC) to Teams Rooms Pro Management Portal (PMP), with TAC deprecation extended to October 2026. Admins must complete migration steps to avoid management disruptions, ensuring devices meet prerequisites and appear in PMP for full functionality.

item.title: MC1388706: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Legal agent available in Frontier worldwide
item.description: Copilot for Legal is now in Public Preview worldwide for Frontier users, expanding beyond the U.S. It helps legal professionals review contracts, identify risks, compare clauses, and generate tracked changes. No separate installation is needed; access requires Frontier enrollment and Copilot licenses.

item.title: MC1227622: Transitioning Teams Android Device Management from Teams admin Center to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal
item.description: Teams Android device management is transitioning from the Teams admin center to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal by July 2026, consolidating management of all Teams devices into one portal. Deprecation of device management in TAC will begin October 2026, with phased rollouts and migration guidance provided.

item.title: MC1479509: Spell check before sending emails in new Outlook
item.description: Starting mid-October to mid-December 2026, new Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web will roll out an automatic spell check before sending emails. Users can enable this feature if Connected Experiences are on. Organizations should review privacy policies and update training accordingly.

item.title: MC1489971: Microsoft Purview DLP: Improved setup and Intune multi-admin approval support for unmanaged apps in Edge for Business
item.description: Starting November 2026, Microsoft Purview DLP will improve setup and support Intune multi-admin approval for unmanaged apps in Edge for Business, offering clearer status, detailed errors, and task coordination between Purview and Intune admins without changing existing policies or enforcement.

item.description: The Link Preview feature in new Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web has been retired due to the deprecation of the browser service needed for previews. Links remain clickable, no action is required, but users should be informed that preview cards will no longer appear.

item.description: Microsoft Viva Insights is expanding Power BI report publishing to leaders, allowing them to publish and distribute reports directly. item.title: MC1489931: Microsoft 365 Backup: Activity Logs
item.description: Microsoft 365 Backup will introduce activity logs by mid-October 2026, enabling administrators to monitor backup and restore activities across SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Exchange Online. item.title: MC1489928: Microsoft Brand Kit: Duplicate an existing Brand Kit
item.description: Microsoft now allows Brand Managers and Brand Kit owners to duplicate existing Brand Kits to create new ones, simplifying setup for different brands or regions. item.title: MC1489926: Microsoft Create: Improved sharing controls for Brand Kits
item.description: Microsoft Create now allows Brand Kit owners to modify sharing permissions after sharing, including changing user access between view and edit or removing access. This feature is available worldwide with no action required, helping organizations better manage Brand Kit access as collaboration needs evolve.

item.title: MC1477185: Microsoft OneDrive: New pay-as-you-go storage billing option
item.description: Microsoft is introducing a pay-as-you-go billing option for additional OneDrive storage, allowing admins to let selected accounts exceed licensed quotas with automatic usage-based billing. Public preview is available now for commercial tenants, with general availability starting November 2026. No action is needed if unused.

item.description: Microsoft Agent 365 will support observability for third-party agents from Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Anthropic Claude, enabling unified monitoring of runs, sessions, and exceptions. Rollout begins late October 2026 with admin controls for enabling data collection and platform-specific setup requirements.

item.description: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention for calendar events starting mid-November 2026, helping organizations prevent sensitive data sharing in meeting details. item.title: MC1472023: [Outlook Mobile] Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events
item.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention for calendar events starting mid-November 2026, helping prevent sensitive data sharing in meeting details. item.description: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview DLP wait-on-send policies starting mid-November 2026, allowing organizations to enforce DLP evaluations before sending emails. item.title: MC1472021: [Outlook Mobile] Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support
item.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview DLP wait-on-send policies starting mid-November 2026, allowing organizations to enforce DLP evaluations before sending emails. Administrators can configure wait times to enhance policy compliance and balance security with user productivity. Review and enable as needed.

item.description: Outlook for Mac will auto-apply or recommend Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels for emails based on attached files' labels, enhancing consistent information protection. Rollout begins mid-November 2026. No admin action is required, but organizations should review label policies and inform relevant teams.

item.title: MC1454113: Microsoft Copilot Word: Document summarization experience moving
item.description: Starting September 2026, Microsoft Word's document summarization will move from the Top of Doc experience to other Copilot surfaces, maintaining AI-powered summaries accessible via Copilot prompts. No admin action is needed, but user communication and training updates are recommended.

item.title: MC1446805: Microsoft Viva: Targeted audience surveys in the Copilot dashboard
item.description: Microsoft Viva introduces targeted audience surveys in the Copilot dashboard, allowing authorized users (CxO or delegates) to send Viva Pulse surveys to predefined Copilot user groups dynamically filtered from dashboard data. item.title: MC1484013: Microsoft Teams: Multi-line call history tabs in the Calls app
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce multi-line call history tabs in the Calls app for users with multi-line calling, organizing call activity by phone line. item.title: MC1485411: Microsoft Excel: Excel canvas
item.description: Excel canvas, a new Copilot feature in Microsoft Excel, creates dynamic reports with visualizations and insights that update automatically with data changes. item.title: MC1486295: Microsoft OneDrive and SharePoint: Generate smart tables of contents for PDFs on the web with Copilot
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot users can generate AI-created, hierarchical, clickable tables of contents for PDFs in OneDrive and SharePoint on the web starting December 2026. The feature is user-initiated, respects permissions, supports saving by editors, and may have inaccuracies, especially with scanned PDFs.

item.title: MC1338816: New Outlook for Windows becomes available for GCC High and DoD
item.description: New Outlook for Windows will be available in GCC High and DoD environments starting Public Preview July 30, 2026, has rolled out. It remains off by default and opt-in, allowing admins control via policies and registry keys. Migration from COM to web add-ins is recommended.

item.title: MC1488847: Microsoft Teams: Breakout room support for Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will support breakout rooms, allowing meeting organizers to assign and move these devices between breakout and main rooms. item.title: MC1488845: Private tasks now stored in your private plan in Planner
item.description: Starting November 2026, private tasks in Microsoft Planner will be stored in users' private Planner plans instead of Microsoft To Do, enabling richer features while remaining private. item.title: MC1488844: Updated My Task experience in Planner
item.description: Microsoft Planner's My Tasks experience will be redesigned for clearer navigation, better task organization, and streamlined task creation, enhancing productivity. item.title: MC1488843: Microsoft Word for Android: Agent Mode
item.description: Microsoft Word for Android will gain Copilot Agent Mode by late September 2026, enabling users to draft, reason, and refine content with AI assistance. item.description: Microsoft Entra ID will retire the MemberOf rule operator by November 3, 2026. item.title: MC1446797: Microsoft Teams: Modernized Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will receive a modernized Gallery view from mid-August to late October 2026, aligning it with Windows. item.title: MC1404321: Microsoft Teams: Emoji shortcuts expand to iOS and Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams is expanding desktop-style emoji shortcuts to iOS and Android, allowing users to insert emojis by typing keywords between colons (e.g., :smile:). The rollout begins mid-August 2026, enhancing mobile emoji input with no admin controls and requiring no user action.

item.description: Users can now customize the classic ribbon in New Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the Web by right-clicking the ribbon on the Home or View tab, selecting Customize, and arranging commands and groups. This feature, rolling out in November 2026, requires admin activation and uses sign-in signals to generate recommendations without automatic changes.

item.description: Legacy Microsoft Teams retention policies will no longer apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions starting late October 2026. Organizations must configure separate retention policies for Copilot data to maintain compliance, as Teams policies will only govern Teams content going forward. Action is required if Copilot retention is needed.

item.title: MC1481310: Pin Copilot app to Windows taskbar for selected user groups
item.description: Microsoft 365 admins can now pin the Copilot app to the Windows taskbar for specific Intune-managed user groups via a new M365 admin center option. This rollout starts late September 2026 and requires the app to be pre-installed. Group-based pinning helps target departments or pilot groups.

item.title: MC1481309: Microsoft Entra ID: Enhance protection of the authentication experience by blocking external script injection
item.description: Microsoft Entra ID will enhance sign-in security by enforcing a Content Security Policy blocking external script injection starting mid-October 2026. Only trusted Microsoft scripts will run, affecting organizations using script-injecting tools on login.microsoftonline.com. No action needed if such tools aren't used.

item.title: MC1456609: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection: Auto-labeling per-policy coverage report
item.description: Microsoft Purview introduces a new auto-labeling policy coverage report to help administrators track labeling progress, identify issues, and assess policy effectiveness. Available after simulations, the report shows labeled, pending, and failed files for 30 days. Rollout begins early October 2026 worldwide. No action required.

item.title: MC1459138: Microsoft Teams: Local Pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) controls for Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will add native local Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) camera controls on the in-room console for compatible cameras, enabling manual adjustments during meetings without extra remotes. Rollout begins September 2026, with automatic enablement on eligible devices and no action required from users.

item.title: MC1479512: Microsoft Teams: Updates to Teams Events licensing for business, frontline, and education customers
item.description: Microsoft Teams Events licensing is updated to categorize features into foundational (available with eligible Teams licenses) and advanced (requiring Teams Enterprise licenses). Teams Premium no longer includes Events capabilities. Event attendee limits vary by license, with capacity packs needed for over 3,000 attendees. Admins must review organizer licenses accordingly.

item.title: MC1472592: Microsoft Purview: Auto-expanding archive capacity increases to 3 TB for eligible mailboxes
item.description: Microsoft Purview increases auto-expanding archive capacity for eligible Exchange Online mailboxes from 1.5 TB to 3 TB starting mid-October 2026. No extra configuration or charges apply. Administrators should verify license eligibility, monitor growth, and update documentation accordingly. Compliance impact is minimal.

item.title: MC1479517: SharePoint: HTML pages
item.description: SharePoint will support creating, uploading, editing, and publishing HTML pages, including Copilot-assisted page creation. Rollout starts October 2026 (preview) and completes December 2026 (general availability). Pages are stored in the Site Pages library with existing permissions. No admin action is required before rollout.

item.title: MC1479513: Outlook: Insert Symbols
item.description: Outlook will allow users to insert symbols into emails via the Insert tab, rolling out worldwide from October to December 2026. No admin action is needed, but users should be informed, and training materials updated. This affects new Outlook for Windows, Outlook on the web, and Exchange Online.

item.title: MC1479508: Microsoft Planner: Meeting-created plans will expire after 180 days of inactivity
item.description: Meeting-created Microsoft Planner plans from Teams expire and delete after 180 days of no task activity, starting October 2026. Organizers get advance email notices and can extend plans by selecting "Keep plan." Tasks in Loop and meeting notes remain unaffected. Deleted plans recoverable within 30 days via admin request.

item.title: MC1479506: Video recap in Microsoft Teams supports more languages
item.description: Microsoft Teams Video recap, which uses AI to create narrated highlight videos from meetings, now supports 23 languages and 31 locale variants. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot license users, it requires meetings to be 10–90 minutes, recorded, and transcribed. Rollout begins late September 2026.

item.title: MC1479505: ADO MCP in Copilot
item.description: The Azure DevOps MCP Connector integrates Azure DevOps with Microsoft 365 Copilot Deep Work, enabling natural-language queries on work items and project data. Rolling out worldwide in October 2026, it supports multi-step workflows, admin controls, and user-confirmed write actions, enhancing project analysis and automation.

item.title: MC1478970: Microsoft Purview | DLP-Create Purview network data security policies without pay-as-you-go configuration
item.description: Microsoft Purview network data security policies can now be created without pay-as-you-go configuration, using Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access with appropriate licensing. Non-Microsoft integrations still require pay-as-you-go. Rollout begins late September 2026, enabling policy creation to protect sensitive data in network traffic automatically.

item.title: MC1187682: Microsoft Edge: Microsoft 365 Copilot will support summarization and contextual grounding
item.description: Microsoft Edge for Business now supports Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat for summarizing and contextualizing multiple browser tabs, YouTube videos (available), and Microsoft 365 documents (rolling out mid-October 2026). The feature is off by default, respects DLP and policy settings, and requires Entra ID sign-in and proper licensing.

item.description: What and why:Three time zone changes affect Windows devices in Alberta, British Columbia, and Morocco, with Windows releasing fixes across September and October 2026. item.title: MC1461157: Microsoft Teams: Proximity join support for attendees in Teams events from Teams Rooms on Windows and Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows and Android will support attendee proximity join for Teams events, enabling users to quickly connect to nearby room systems. Rollout starts November 2026, completing by December. No action is needed; the feature will be enabled automatically to simplify joining meetings.

item.title: MC1478463: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Teams user reporting enabled by default
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will enable Teams user reporting by default starting late October 2026 for licensed organizations. Users can report suspicious Teams content to improve threat detection. Admins can review or opt out via a dedicated Defender portal page before October 25, 2026.

item.title: MC1442614: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced IntelliFrame with AI data channel for intelligent cameras
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will gain enhanced IntelliFrame AI features via certified intelligent cameras, enabling faster speaker framing, participant recognition, and smoother views, especially in low bandwidth. AI processing occurs on-device with metadata sent through a dedicated channel. Rollout begins mid-January 2027, enabled by default, requiring no admin action.

item.title: MC1479276: Microsoft Copilot: Evolving the Copilot pricing model and new FinOps capabilities for AI
item.description: Microsoft is evolving Copilot's pricing with a user subscription license for everyday AI and usage-based billing (UBB) for advanced AI via Copilot Credits. New FinOps tools enable admins to manage costs, spending policies, and monitor usage. UBB rolls out in Q4 2026; admins must set policies to enable credit use.

item.title: MC1478969: Deprecation of Citrix mVPN Support in Microsoft Edge for Android
item.description: Microsoft Edge for Android will retire Citrix Mobile VPN (mVPN) integration starting mid-September 2026 due to compatibility issues. Organizations using this integration must identify affected users, assess dependencies, plan migration to alternative solutions, and communicate changes before support ends. Other Edge features remain unaffected.

item.title: MC1478966: SharePoint: Improved site metadata size reporting
item.description: SharePoint will improve site metadata size reporting by including document library field data, providing a more complete usage view. The 1 TB metadata limit remains, but reported sizes may increase, potentially blocking new metadata additions if exceeded. Rollout starts October 20, 2026, with no content changes.

item.title: MC1478962: Microsoft Teams: Review Conditional Access policies to prevent sign-in issues on Teams Android devices
item.description: Microsoft is rolling out stricter Conditional Access policies for Teams Android devices by mid-October 2026, which may cause sign-in issues if resource-specific policies block access. Organizations should review and adjust exclusions in Conditional Access policies and check sign-in logs to resolve problems.

item.title: MC1478961: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint for Windows: Organization skill support
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint for Windows will support organization skills that admins can upload and share tenant-wide via the Microsoft 365 admin center, enabling centralized governance and consistent user experiences. Rollout begins September 2026, with no immediate action required unless publishing skills.

item.title: MC1478960: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint for Mac: Organization skill support
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint for Mac will support organization skills that admins can upload and share tenant-wide via the Microsoft 365 admin center, enabling centralized governance and consistent user experiences. Rollout begins September 2026, with no immediate action required unless publishing skills.

item.title: MC1478957: Microsoft 365 profile card: View dotted-line managers in the organization panel
item.description: Microsoft 365 profile cards will show dotted-line managers in the organization panel starting October 2026, helping users understand complex reporting structures. This additive update requires organizations to provide dotted-line manager data via HR systems like SAP SuccessFactors or Workday. No action is required unless enabling this feature.

item.title: MC1478956: Microsoft Windows Autopatch: enhancements to update approval control and management capabilities
item.description: Windows Autopatch enhancements, rolling out Sept 1–Oct 15, 2026, offer improved control over Windows quality, .NET Framework, and quick machine recovery updates. Features include customizable automatic/manual approvals, deferral settings, update pausing, and detailed per-device reporting for better update management.

item.title: MC1478955: Final reminder: Microsoft Project Online retires on September 30, 2026
item.description: Microsoft Project Online will retire on September 30, 2026. Users must migrate to alternatives like Microsoft Planner, Project Server Subscription Edition, or Project Operations before then to avoid data loss. Organizations should contact a Microsoft partner immediately to plan the transition and notify users accordingly.

item.title: MC1478949: Breakout Rooms for Microsoft Teams Webinars now support up to 1,000 participants and 100 rooms
item.description: Breakout Rooms in Microsoft Teams webinars now support up to 1,000 participants and 100 rooms, enabling large-scale interactive sessions like training and workshops. No admin action is needed; organizers should be informed and guidance updated accordingly. No compliance issues identified. Available now.

item.title: MC1478946: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Extended rollback support for Monthly Enterprise Channel
item.description: Microsoft 365 Apps Cloud Update will allow Monthly Enterprise Channel devices to roll back to releases from two versions prior with security updates, maintaining that state until updates resume. Rolling out worldwide in September 2026, this feature enhances recovery options without automatic changes to devices.

item.title: MC1307888: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams is expanding AI-powered meeting notes with the Facilitator agent to Teams Rooms on Android, enabling real-time note-taking during in-person meetings. Notes are securely stored in tenant-owned SharePoint and accessible via meeting recap. Rollout begins early November 2026, requiring Teams Rooms Pro licenses and specific tenant settings.

item.title: MC1478467: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Admin-configurable compliance URL in M365 Copilot data access messages
item.description: Microsoft Purview DLP now lets admins configure the destination URL for the "Learn about access restrictions" link in Microsoft 365 Copilot data access messages. This directs users to organization-specific compliance guidance instead of Microsoft's public documentation. The feature rolls out worldwide in late September 2026 and requires admin configuration.

item.title: MC1392568: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint: Support for Amazon Linux 2 (ARM64) retiring October 31, 2026
item.description: Support for Microsoft Defender for Endpoint on Amazon Linux 2 (ARM64) will retire on October 31, 2026. After this date, no updates or support will be provided. Organizations must identify affected devices, prevent upgrades beyond version 101.25122.0004, and migrate to a supported Linux distribution before the deadline.

item.title: MC1388718: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint: Update to Linux connectivity requirements with new service URLs to allowlist
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint on Linux now requires allowlisting new service URLs specific to tenant types for delivering internal configuration updates, feature rollouts, and critical issue mitigations. This update is available worldwide, with no change to user experience, and ensures devices receive the latest features and optimizations.

item.title: MC1478006: Microsoft Word for the web: Retirement of the "@" entity insertion experience on the document canvas
item.description: Microsoft is retiring the CIQ-based "@" entity insertion on Word for the web's document canvas by late October 2026, aligning it with other Microsoft 365 apps. Users cannot invoke this menu anymore, but @mentions in comments remain unaffected. No admin action is required; users should be informed.

item.title: MC1478004: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Retirement of the Sites control in Researcher
item.description: The Sites control in Microsoft 365 Copilot Researcher for Frontier users will be retired by late September 2026. Users can still specify preferred websites directly in prompts. No admin action or new settings are needed; existing web search controls remain unchanged. Inform users and update documentation accordingly.

item.title: MC1478003: Microsoft Teams: Admins can control profanity filtering in meeting transcripts
item.description: Microsoft Teams will let admins control profanity filtering in meeting transcripts via a new meeting policy setting, on by default. Turning it off allows profane words to appear in live and saved transcripts. This affects meeting policies, not participant caption preferences, and rolls out October 2026.

item.title: MC1477996: Retirement of Viva Insights (personal insights) and Viva Learning usage reports
item.description: Viva Insights personal insights and Viva Learning usage reports will be retired from the Microsoft 365 admin center by mid-November 2026. Admins should access Viva Learning metrics directly in the app and update documentation and communications accordingly.

item.title: MC1477993: Case Management in Microsoft Defender
item.description: Microsoft Defender introduces native Case Management to unify threat investigations, assign analysts, track SLAs, and capture notes in one workspace. Launching in public preview September 2026, it integrates with existing workflows and permissions, enhancing security team coordination and response efficiency without requiring manual migration.

item.title: MC1317197: Microsoft Teams: A refreshed in-meeting experience with simpler controls and a smarter share panel
item.description: Microsoft Teams is updating meeting controls and the share panel to simplify use, reduce accidental actions, and improve sharing confidence. Changes include center-aligned controls, a separated Leave button, customizable controls, and a redesigned share panel with live previews and two-step sharing. Rollout spans July 2026 to January 2027 across desktop and web platforms. No tenant-level disable option; users can temporarily opt out during rollout. item.title: MC1477180: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps: Retirement of EWS detections in App Governance
item.description: Exchange Web Services (EWS) in Exchange Online will be retired starting October 1, 2026, with related Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps app governance detections ending October 15, 2026. Organizations not using EWS need no action; those continuing EWS use will lose related alerts and should migrate away from EWS.

item.title: MC1470424: Microsoft Viva Engage: New left navigation controls for collapsing, resizing, and managing favorites
item.description: Microsoft Viva Engage is updating its left navigation with features to collapse, resize, reorder, and favorite unlimited communities. These user-initiated enhancements improve organization and efficiency across web, Teams, and Outlook platforms, rolling out worldwide by October 2026 with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1409042: Microsoft OneNote: Copilot notebook available in OneNote on Mac
item.description: Copilot Notebook, a new AI-powered workspace in OneNote on Mac, helps users organize and analyze notes using Microsoft 365 Copilot. It requires a Copilot license, is enabled by default, and will roll out worldwide from late August to mid-October 2026. No admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1477182: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is expanding to cover Microsoft Cowork, applying existing and new DLP policies from Microsoft Copilot automatically. This includes sensitivity label grounding, prompt blocking, and web search DLP for sensitive data. Rollout begins late September 2026 with no required user action.

item.title: MC1477181: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection: Apply default SharePoint library sensitivity labels to data at rest
item.description: Microsoft Purview will enable an auto-labeling policy to apply default SharePoint library sensitivity labels to existing files, improving labeling coverage without user action. This opt-in feature, rolling out in October 2026, requires administrator configuration and supports up to 10 SharePoint sites per policy.

item.title: MC1447682: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced live captions settings and right-side panel view
item.description: Microsoft Teams is enhancing live captions with a new right-side panel view and a consolidated settings menu for easier configuration. Users can auto-enable captions, submit feedback, and benefit from synchronized translation settings. Rollout begins mid-August 2026, completing worldwide by October 2026, with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1443520: Microsoft Teams: Specify who has control of production tools in meetings and webinars
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a default meeting option allowing organizers to specify who controls production tools in meetings and webinars, improving event management by assigning production roles separately from presenters. Rollout starts mid-August 2026, completing by October 2026, with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1429012: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced delegated calling with delegate call access restrictions and join notifications
item.description: Microsoft Teams is enhancing call delegation with a new "Lock an Ongoing Call" feature to restrict delegate participation and an optional warning tone notifying when a delegate joins or resumes a call. These updates improve privacy and transparency during delegated calls, rolling out globally from August to October 2026.

item.title: MC1332816: Scoped SharePoint search in Teams (SharePoint app, also called Viva Connections)
item.description: Starting end of June 2026, Teams' SharePoint app (Viva Connections) search will scope results to SharePoint content, showing suggestions in Teams and opening results in SharePoint. The feature is default-enabled, respects permissions, requires no admin changes, and aims to improve search relevance within Teams.

item.title: MC1324280: Assign open shifts in Microsoft Teams Shifts
item.description: Microsoft Teams Shifts introduces "Assign open shifts," enabling managers to automatically assign open shifts based on availability, time off, historical patterns, and rules. Rolling out worldwide from mid-June to October 2026, the feature is optional, reviewable before publishing, and controlled by existing scheduling permissions.

item.title: MC1317836: Microsoft Teams: Unblock users to send message while file is uploading in the background
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow users to send messages while files upload asynchronously in the background, improving real-time collaboration. This update, rolling out from August to October 2026, affects all platforms and requires no action. Compliance and file-sharing policies remain unchanged.

item.title: MC1316231: Microsoft Teams: Front-of-room view control for Webinars and structured meetings in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will default front-of-room displays to attendee view during webinars and structured meetings starting mid-June 2026, enhancing in-room participant experience. Presenters keep full control via console. The feature requires a Teams Rooms Pro license, is enabled by default, and needs no user action.

item.title: MC1323270: Microsoft Teams: Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) support for Teams meetings and events
item.description: Microsoft Teams will support Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) for town halls and live events starting June 2026, alongside existing RTMP. SRT offers improved reliability with backup streams and automatic failover. IT admins must enable SRT via policy. No impact on attendees; existing workflows remain supported.

item.title: MC1251206: Microsoft Teams: Identify external bots joining your Teams meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will detect and label external meeting assistant bots joining meetings, giving organizers control to approve, deny, or remove them. A new admin policy will manage bot handling. Rollout begins mid-May 2026, completing by October 2026, enhancing meeting security and compliance.

item.title: MC1257308: Microsoft Teams: Building‑level insights on the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal recommended actions page
item.description: Microsoft is adding building-level insights to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal's recommended actions page, highlighting buildings with high Teams Rooms usage and BYOD rooms to improve consistency. This feature, enabled by default for eligible licenses, will roll out from mid-June to October 2026 worldwide. No action is required.

item.title: MC1261595: Microsoft Teams town halls now support backup Real-Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP) streams
item.description: Microsoft Teams town halls will support backup RTMP streams to improve live event reliability, automatically switching to a secondary stream if the primary fails. This feature, available by default with no admin setup needed, rolls out worldwide from late April to October 2026, affecting organizers using RTMP workflows.

item.title: MC1256307: Microsoft Teams: Recently used emojis sync across devices
item.description: Microsoft Teams will sync recently used emojis and reactions across all devices by late July 2026 (general availability). The feature is enabled by default, requires no user action, and maintains existing admin settings without impacting data flow or compliance. Admins may update documentation or inform support teams.

item.title: MC1045221: Microsoft Teams: New user setting to view incoming calls in a small window
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new default setting allowing users to view incoming calls in a small, resizable window to reduce disruption. The feature will roll out from May 2025 to October 2026 across all platforms, requiring no admin action but user notification is recommended.

item.title: MC1476977: Skills in Declarative Agents becoming generally available
item.description: Skills in Declarative Agents, modular reusable capabilities for Microsoft 365 Copilot, will be generally available worldwide by end of September 2026. They enhance scalability, security, and governance without requiring action. Organizations using Information Barriers are currently unsupported. Existing governance and compliance controls remain in effect.

item.title: MC1476322: Customized PowerBI reports behavior after major report updates
item.description: Microsoft Viva Insights customized Power BI reports will remain tied to their original report versions and won’t auto-update with major report changes. Users must create new customized reports from the latest versions to access updated data and features. No admin action or policy changes are needed.

item.title: MC1476319: Microsoft SharePoint: Changes to the FAQ web part authoring experience
item.description: The SharePoint FAQ web part will shift AI-assisted FAQ creation to Copilot in SharePoint, while retaining manual FAQ editing in the web part. Rollout starts late October 2026. Existing content remains unchanged, requiring no migration. No admin action needed; inform authors and update training accordingly.

item.title: MC1476316: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Federated Copilot connectors support create, update, and delete actions
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot's federated connectors will support create, update, and delete actions in third-party services starting October 2026. Actions require user approval and use the user's permissions. Administrators can review and disable connectors via the admin center. No user action is needed to receive this feature.

item.title: MC1476269: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Updates to the Researcher experience
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot is updating Researcher to use shared Copilot components, retiring specific controls and tabs by December 30, 2026. Core research functions remain, but users must adapt to new navigation. No admin action is needed; admins should update documentation and inform users.

item.title: MC1476237: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Remediation actions from the Teams message entity flyout
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will enhance the Teams message entity flyout by late September 2026, enabling security admins to submit messages to Microsoft and block senders or domains in one workflow. This streamlines Teams message investigations for Plan 1 and Plan 2 customers without requiring configuration changes.

item.title: MC1476216: Plan for Change: Web based device enrollment will become default method for iOS/iPadOS device enrollment
item.description: Starting early 2027, web-based device enrollment will be the default for new iOS/iPadOS enrollment profiles in Intune. Existing profiles remain unchanged. Admins must deploy the SSO extension policy for just-in-time registration. Company Portal remains available but is not required for enrollment. Update documentation accordingly.

item.description: Microsoft is retiring the Surveys agent by August 31, 2026, transitioning users to a unified Copilot-powered experience within Microsoft Forms. item.description: Microsoft 365 eSignature introduces recipient groups, allowing up to 10 people per recipient slot, with the first signer fulfilling the requirement. item.title: MC1474455: In-app browsing in Copilot app
item.description: The Microsoft Copilot app now supports in-app browsing on Windows and Mac, allowing users to open websites side-by-side with chat. item.title: MC1474461: Browser Use Admin Control for Copilot Cowork
item.description: Admins can now control browser use in Copilot Cowork via Microsoft 365 admin center, enabling access for specific users or groups. item.title: MC1474458: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Power BI reports as references in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Copilot Notebooks now support adding Power BI reports as references, enhancing summaries with real business data. Public preview starts late September 2026; general availability begins late October 2026. No extra setup is needed if Power BI and Copilot are already enabled. Organizations without Power BI see no change.

item.title: MC1249424: Microsoft Purview DLP: Unmanaged cloud app protection with Microsoft Purview and the Island Enterprise Browser
item.description: Microsoft Purview now integrates with the Island Enterprise Browser to extend data loss prevention and network data security to browser-based workflows. Available from late March 2026 (preview) and June 2027 (general availability), admins must enable this feature to inspect and protect data shared via Island-managed browsers using existing Purview policies.

item.title: MC1384415: Microsoft Purview | Endpoint Data Loss Prevention now supports a pre‑curated file extension list
item.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP now uses a pre-curated list of supported, scannable file extensions for policy configuration, improving accuracy and enforcement consistency. Free-form file extension entry is removed. Rollout starts mid-December 2026. Existing policies remain unchanged unless edited, requiring unsupported extensions to be removed.

item.title: MC1469960: Microsoft Exchange Online: Review and configure EWSAllowedAppIDs before Exchange Web Services access changes
item.description: Microsoft is updating how EWSAllowedAppIDs is applied in Exchange Online as part of EWS retirement starting October 1, 2026. item.description: Microsoft 365 companion apps (Calendar, People, Files) will retire on December 16, 2026, ceasing support and functionality. Users should be informed and guided accordingly.

item.title: MC1474107: Microsoft Purview: Archive file classification behavior change for Endpoint Data Loss Prevention on Windows endpoints
item.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP on Windows will classify archive files (.zip, .rar) as single atomic objects, reporting only the outer archive in events. item.title: MC1474104: Microsoft Entra ID: Follow-up on SMS first-factor sign-in retirement and upcoming changes
item.description: Microsoft is retiring SMS first-factor sign-in for Microsoft Entra ID workforce tenants worldwide starting February 1, 2027, to enhance security. Organizations must identify affected users, migrate them to phishing-resistant methods like passkeys, and update policies to avoid sign-in disruptions and comply with new requirements.

item.title: MC1473151: Microsoft Edge: IE mode is supported through at least the end of 2029, plan your migration
item.description: IE mode in Microsoft Edge is supported through at least the end of 2029. Organizations using it should inventory dependencies, assess modernization options, and plan migrations early to avoid disruption. No immediate action is required if IE mode is not used. Microsoft offers free App Assure support for compatibility issues.

item.title: MC1454391: Retirement Notice of Learning Coach Agent in M365 Copilot
item.description: The Learning Coach Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot will transition to Learning Agent starting October 2026 and retire by late December 2026. Users must switch to Learning Agent before then. The agent will be removed from user access and admin management by early 2027. Communication and updates are recommended.

item.description: We are announcing the ability to improve Not-To-Exceed (NTE) reliability and validation coverage in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. item.title: MC1458480: Microsoft Edge: Security Update Alerts in the Edge management service
item.description: Microsoft Edge management service will allow admins to set severity thresholds for security update alerts, including zero-day fixes, to reduce unnecessary notifications. The feature rolls out worldwide from mid-October to end of October 2026 automatically, with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1473166: Brand Skill support now available in PPT Copilot [Desktop]
item.description: Brand managers can now upload custom presentation skills as Markdown files to Brand Kit for use with Copilot in PowerPoint Desktop, enabling consistent, organization-approved presentation guidance. Rollout begins mid-September 2026. Organizations should manage governance, review skills regularly, and ensure compliance with policies.

item.title: MC1473165: Brand Skill support now available in PPT Copilot [Web]
item.description: Brand managers can upload custom presentation skills as Markdown files to Brand Kit for use with Copilot in PowerPoint Web, enabling consistent, reusable guidance for presentations. Rolling out worldwide in September 2026, this requires governance, testing, and communication within organizations. Compliance and licensing must be reviewed.

item.title: MC1473163: Brand Skill support now available in PPT Copilot [Mac]
item.description: Brand Skill support in PowerPoint Copilot for Mac lets brand managers upload and share custom presentation skills as Markdown files via Brand Kit, guiding consistent presentation creation. Rolling out September 2026, it requires governance, testing, and compliance checks before publishing for organizational use.

item.title: MC1473156: Plan for Change: Intune migration for Windows Health Attestation to Microsoft Azure Attestation for Windows 11 devices
item.description: Intune will migrate Windows Health Attestation from Device Health Attestation to Microsoft Azure Attestation by early 2027. Organizations must ensure network access to Azure Attestation endpoints to maintain compliance evaluation for Windows 11 devices using health-based policies, or risk compliance failures.

item.title: MC1473149: Loading Power Query data to Python in Excel Web: Retirement
item.description: Microsoft will retire support for loading Power Query data into Python in Excel for the web on October 16, 2026. This affects users combining Power Query and Python in Excel for the web but not Excel desktop. No admin action is needed; affected users should be notified and workflows reviewed.

item.title: MC1473148: Microsoft 365 Usage Reporting Updates (Microsoft Browser and Visio)
item.description: Microsoft is updating Microsoft Browser and Visio usage reports on September 21, 2026, improving metric accuracy and including more apps. Active-user counts may rise, but historical data won't change. Administrators should review reports, note the baseline change date, and validate API integrations.

item.title: MC1472598: Microsoft 365: Find more actions in the suite header menu
item.description: Microsoft 365 is moving some suite header actions, including Settings, My Day, and Sync, into the More (...) menu to reduce clutter and improve discoverability. The change, rolling out from September to November 2026, requires no admin action but may need user communication and documentation updates.

item.title: MC1426371: Microsoft Entra: Passkeys by default and retirement of Microsoft-provided SMS and voice authentication
item.description: Passkeys became the default Microsoft Entra authentication on September 1, 2026. Microsoft-provided SMS and voice authentication will retire February 1, 2027, requiring customers to use telecom providers from the Microsoft Security Store. Transition to passkeys is recommended for stronger, phishing-resistant security.

item.title: MC1469957: [Whiteboard] Legacy Whiteboard migration to OneDrive
item.description: Updated September 15, 2026: This message does not apply to Government customers. We apologize for the confusion, and you can safely disregard this message. Microsoft Whiteboard is migrating from legacy Azure-based storage to OneDrive-backed storage. Migration must be completed by September 25, 2026; afterward, legacy Whiteboards become read-only and are deleted by October 16, 2026. Admins should inventory, notify users, and ensure migration before these deadlines.

item.title: MC1472007: Manage who can upload advanced agents and plugins
item.description: Starting September 25, Microsoft 365 admins can control who uploads advanced Copilot agents and plugins, limiting access to specific users or Entra ID groups. This governance feature rolls out worldwide by October 2026, with default uploads enabled unless admins configure restrictions by October 25. Basic uploads remain unaffected.

item.title: MC1446799: Microsoft Teams: Multilingual meeting recaps support personalized recap translation
item.description: Microsoft Teams meeting recaps will now personalize recap translations based on each participant's selected language during the meeting. Users can view recaps initially in their chosen language and switch to other supported languages. The rollout begins August 2026 with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1472429: Support for Office LTSC 2021, and additional apps will end on October 13, 2026
item.description: Support for Office LTSC 2021 and related apps ends October 13, 2026, with no further updates or support. Users should upgrade to Microsoft 365 Apps or Office LTSC 2024 to maintain security, compliance, and performance before that date.

item.title: MC1461153: Microsoft Teams: Add multiple steps when building a workflow from scratch
item.description: Microsoft Teams Workflows will soon support multiple actions in a single workflow, enabling richer automations that reduce manual tasks, consolidate processes, and improve productivity. The rollout starts early September 2026, requiring no admin action, and offers a simpler, step-based workflow design for users.

item.title: MC856756: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows: Native PTZ controls
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will support native PTZ camera controls in the Camera settings menu when Enhanced Framing is off. Rollout begins late September 2026 worldwide, with admin toggle enabled by default. No pre-rollout action is needed, but user notification and documentation updates are recommended.

item.title: MC1462471: Microsoft SharePoint : Dashboard Card Visibility on Mobile
item.description: Microsoft SharePoint now allows dashboard authors to control individual card visibility on mobile devices, enhancing mobile user experience. The rollout begins mid-September 2026 and completes by month-end. No action is required, but authors are encouraged to optimize dashboards for mobile users. Existing settings remain unchanged.

item.title: MC1472030: Writing Blocks in M365 Copilot
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will introduce Writing blocks by mid-September 2026, enabling users to create and refine longer-form content like emails and reports within Copilot. This feature enhances productivity by providing a dedicated editing workspace without leaving Copilot. No action is required, but user communication is recommended.

item.title: MC1472029: Code Blocks in M365 Copilot
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will support inline previews of code blocks, charts, and diagrams within conversations, eliminating the need for a separate code canvas. This rollout begins mid-September 2026 worldwide, enhancing user experience without requiring action, though user notification and training updates are recommended.

item.title: MC1472025: Microsoft SharePoint: PowerShell support for brand fonts deletion
item.description: Microsoft SharePoint will introduce the Remove-SPOFontFile PowerShell cmdlet by mid-October 2026, allowing admins to delete brand fonts across geographies. Deleted fonts fallback to Microsoft-defined fonts on sites, while font packages remain with warnings. This requires Public CDN enabled and PowerShell module updates.

item.title: MC1387575: Microsoft Purview | Endpoint Data Loss Prevention: Scope Just-in-time audit by user or group
item.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint Data Loss Prevention now requires admins to explicitly configure which users or groups are audited under Just-in-time protection, enhancing control and reducing audit noise. Rollout begins mid-December 2026. Admins must update configurations and deploy anti-malware client version 4.18.26060 or later.

item.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP will protect sensitive files in previously excluded Windows folders (e.g., AppData) during key egress actions starting mid-December 2026. Admins must update policies, deploy anti-malware client 4.18.26051+, and educate users. Audit mode logs actions; block mode enforces restrictions.

item.title: MC1093912: Microsoft Outlook for iOS/Android: Improved Contacts with profile enrichment and duplicate management
item.description: Microsoft Outlook Mobile (iOS/Android) will unify duplicate contacts and enrich profiles with organizational info, improving contact views. Rollout starts mid-July 2025 and completes by mid-November 2026, with no admin action needed. Users should update to the latest app version after rollout.

item.title: MC1230457: Moderation approvals now available across Outlook apps
item.description: Moderation approvals in Exchange Online will use Actionable Messages adaptive cards across all Outlook clients starting early March 2026, completing by mid-October. Dual-mode approvals end July 31, 2026. Organizations should enable Actionable Messages and update documentation and support accordingly.

item.title: MC1420901: Notebooks in the M365 Copilot App
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot app will introduce updated Notebooks by late September 2026, syncing with OneNote to organize chats, content, and references in a persistent workspace. Users with a Copilot license can access and continue work across both apps without changes to existing data or OneNote Notebooks. No admin action required.

item.title: MC1282567: Create charts on pages with AI in SharePoint
item.description: SharePoint will introduce an AI-assisted Charts web part by mid-2026, enabling page authors with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license to create and edit interactive charts using plain-language prompts. The feature is enabled by default, requires no action to prepare, and maintains existing permissions and policies.

item.title: MC1470901: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced real-time alerting rule management in the Teams admin center
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enhance Real-Time Alerting rule management in the Teams admin center by enabling rule duplication, bulk user uploads, and direct rule deletion. Administrators can monitor up to 500 users for In-Progress Meetings and Calls. These features roll out worldwide starting late September 2026, enabled by default.

item.title: MC1470885: M365 Copilot: Tell Copilot what you need directly from the Copilot button in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot adds a new prompt input directly on the Copilot button in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint for faster, contextual content creation. Rolling out worldwide from September to December 2026 on Windows, macOS, and web, it requires no admin action but updates to training and documentation.

item.title: MC1470884: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: Select user-owned SharePoint Embedded containers as a data source
item.description: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery will support selecting user-owned SharePoint Embedded containers as data sources for cases, searches, and holds starting mid-September 2026. This enables discovery of content from Microsoft Loop, Copilot Pages, and Notebooks, enhancing compliance investigations without changing permissions. No admin action is required.

item.title: MC1470883: Microsoft Outlook for iPad: Minimize email drafts and return to them later
item.description: Outlook for iPad will allow users to compose emails in a separate window and minimize drafts to return later, enhancing multitasking. This feature rolls out worldwide from mid-September to mid-October 2026, with behavior depending on iPadOS multitasking settings. No admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1470881: Microsoft Purview: Removing pay-as-you-go requirements for Edge for Business DLP unmanaged app protections
item.description: Starting mid-October 2026, Microsoft Purview will remove the pay-as-you-go billing requirement for inline collection and DLP policies protecting unmanaged cloud apps in Microsoft Edge for Business. Existing policies and protections remain unchanged, no action is required, and billing checks will be removed for this scenario.

item.title: MC1470871: Microsoft Graph: User.ReadBasic.All will no longer allow reading user app role assignments and license details
item.description: User.ReadBasic.All will no longer provide access to user app role assignments and license details starting mid-September 2026 to fix a security issue. Applications needing this data must switch to User.Read.All or LicenseAssignment.Read.All permissions and update accordingly to avoid disruptions.

item.title: MC1470869: Plan for Change: Removal of legacy Apple MDM software updates
item.description: Apple has ended support for legacy MDM software update commands with OS 27. Intune will remove the legacy update UI in its October release. Admins must switch to declarative device management (DDM) for Apple software updates to ensure devices continue updating properly. Review and update policies accordingly.

item.title: MC1181769: Microsoft Purview: Integration with Entra GSA Internet Access to enable sensitive file filtering at the network layer
item.description: Microsoft Purview DLP integrates with Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access to filter sensitive files at the network layer, preventing data leaks to unmanaged cloud apps. Public preview starts mid-November 2025; general availability by October 2026. Admins must configure policies, TLS inspection, and activate Purview pay-as-you-go.

item.title: MC1454996: Copilot Chat can float over your Outlook iPad and Mac window
item.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook for Mac and iPad can now pop out into a floating window, allowing users to resize, reposition, and manage it separately from the main Outlook window. The rollout starts late August 2026 and completes by mid-October 2026, with no action required.

item.title: MC1470426: Data Privacy: Microsoft Online Services Subprocessor Disclosure
item.description: A Data Privacy message regarding your organization is available within Message Center. The contents of this message can be accessed within Message Center by a Global Administrator or someone designated as a Message Center Privacy Reader. Please sign in to Admin Center to view the details of this message in the M365 Message center.

item.title: MC1411432: Viva Engage: New post creation experience
item.description: Viva Engage’s post creation experience will be updated by mid-October 2026 with a simpler, more intuitive layout, improved accessibility, and clearer tool organization. No admin action is needed; users should be informed and support materials updated accordingly. Existing capabilities remain unchanged.

item.description: On October 13, 2026, Windows Server 2022 will reach end of mainstream support. item.title: MC1413304: Viva Engage: New Recent feed in Home
item.description: Microsoft Viva Engage introduces a new Recent feed in Home for a chronological view of content from followed communities, people, and priority communications, complementing the existing personalized For you feed. It rolls out worldwide from mid-August to early October 2026 with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1455014: Microsoft Teams: Teams Events Attendance and Engagement Report Policy
item.description: Microsoft is introducing a new policy separating Teams Events attendance and engagement report controls from Teams Meetings, managed via CsTeamsEventsPolicy. Rollout starts November 2026. Administrators can independently configure report access with four policy options. Review and update settings and documentation accordingly after rollout.

item.title: MC1156360: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot Chat for Teams Chats, Channels, Calling, and Meetings
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is now integrated side-by-side in Teams Chats, Channels, Calling, and Meetings for licensed users on desktop and web. New in-meeting controls allow stopping audio processing. Rollouts occur from October 2025 to September 2026. Admins must enable the Copilot app for access.

item.title: MC1470425: Microsoft Copilot Cost Management: September Updates
item.description: September 2026 updates to Microsoft Copilot Cost Management introduce auto-application of new services to spending policies, user spending alerts, expanded and enhanced consumption reporting, custom approval workflows, and improved policy health guidance. Admins should review policies, configure notifications, and familiarize with new reporting features.

item.title: MC1470416: Microsoft OneDrive and SharePoint: Anchored comments in the PDF viewer
item.description: Microsoft is adding anchored comments to the PDF viewer in OneDrive and SharePoint on the web, enabling users to comment on specific spots or text, collaborate with replies and @mentions, with rollout from mid-October to mid-November 2026, on by default and requiring no admin action.

item.title: MC1282683: Create and edit SharePoint pages with Copilot-powered AI
item.description: SharePoint page editors with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license can now use an AI-powered authoring panel to create and edit pages via natural language prompts, leveraging existing Microsoft 365 content. The feature, rolling out worldwide by September 2026, is enabled by default and allows switching between AI and manual editing.

item.title: MC1466753: Microsoft Word: Similarity Checker retirement
item.description: Microsoft Word's Similarity Checker will be retired on October 3, 2027, and removed from Microsoft Editor. Other writing and editing features, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, remain unaffected. Organizations should review workflows, inform users, and consider alternatives if needed. No action or compliance issues are required.

item.title: MC1430536: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Unified alert queue
item.description: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is unifying classic alerts and AI-driven triage into a single alert queue, enhancing analyst efficiency with integrated agent insights, filtering, and prioritization. The classic experience will be deprecated by October 2026, with a 60-day transition period and no immediate action required.

item.title: MC1469962: Change in sender email address for Copilot emails
item.description: Microsoft is updating the sender email for Copilot-related educational and enablement emails to microsoftcopilotupdates@microsoft.com by mid-September 2026. Organizations should update mail flow rules and safe sender lists accordingly. The email content remains unchanged, and no tenant action is required for rollout.

item.title: MC1466751: Microsoft Teams: Lobby visibility will align with the "Who can admit from lobby" meeting option
item.description: Starting early September 2026, Microsoft Teams will align lobby visibility with the "Who can admit from lobby" setting, so only those allowed to admit participants can see the lobby. This change improves privacy, is automatic, and may affect meeting workflows involving presenters monitoring the lobby.

item.title: MC1461164: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: room users can change the app language
item.description: Teams Rooms on Android will allow users to temporarily change the app language per session from the console, aligning with Windows experience. This feature rolls out from June to October 2026 with app version 2.12.0+, resets after restart, requires no admin action, and does not affect system settings.

item.title: MC1146821: Rewrite with Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat coming soon to Edge for Business users
item.description: Microsoft Edge for Business will roll out the Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat-powered Rewrite feature by late October 2026, enabling users to draft and rephrase text via right-click. It’s enabled by default, respects DLP policies, and can be managed by admins through the InlineComposeEnabled policy.

item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new admin policy to automatically block identified external meeting bots from joining meetings, enhancing security. The rollout starts mid-September 2026, with default off. Admins can enable and assign this policy; no changes occur unless activated. Recommendations include piloting and communication.

item.title: MC1469557: [Whiteboard] Standalone app deprecation (Windows, Mobile)
item.description: Microsoft will retire standalone Whiteboard apps for Windows, iOS, and Android on October 16, 2026. Users must switch to accessing Whiteboard via Microsoft Teams or supported web experiences. Admins should inform users, update resources, and ensure readiness for this transition.

item.title: MC1222978: Microsoft 365 Copilot: User-day export for Copilot dashboard metrics in public preview
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot dashboard now offers a public preview of a user-day export option, providing de-identified daily usage data for the past 28 days to eligible users with company-level access. This supports detailed short-term analysis and requires at least 50 Copilot licenses. General availability is expected late 2026.

item.title: MC1466762: Cross-post SharePoint News to Engage
item.description: SharePoint News can now be cross-posted to Viva Engage communities with full fidelity and unified conversations across feeds, Outlook, Teams, and apps. Rolling out worldwide from late September to October 2026, this feature synchronizes comments and reactions, enhancing content reach without extra effort. Admins should inform users accordingly.

item.title: MC1461700: Session and Response Sharing in M365 Copilot
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will enable users to share entire chat sessions or individual responses via shareable links within their organization, offering read-only access and continuation in personal chats. Rollout occurs late August to September 2026. The feature is enabled by default but can be disabled tenant-wide by admins.

item.title: MC1467357: Microsoft Teams: Updated header and dashboard for chats and channels on mobile
item.description: Microsoft Teams mobile will feature a redesigned header and lightweight dashboard for chats and channels, improving navigation and access to key details. Rolling out from late September to early October 2026, this update aligns mobile with desktop experience and requires no user action.

item.title: MC1467356: Deprecation for Manifest V2 (MV2) browser extensions support in Microsoft Edge
item.description: Microsoft Edge will retire Manifest V2 (MV2) extensions by early 2027, fully switching to Manifest V3 (MV3) for improved security and performance. MV2 extensions will be disabled, blocked from new installs, and policies supporting MV2 removed. Enterprises must migrate to MV3 before the deprecation deadline.

item.title: MC1467355: Power BI subscriptions: Changes to notification delivery and sender experience
item.description: Power BI is updating subscription notification delivery to improve reliability and sender reputation, changing sender identity, email formatting, and Copilot summary presentation. The phased rollout starts late September 2026 through January 2027. No subscription recreation is needed, but organizations should review mail rules relying on the old sender identity.

item.title: MC1387814: Microsoft Teams: RTMP-In port and domain changes required
item.description: Microsoft Teams is updating RTMP-In port and domain requirements to improve streaming reliability. Admins must allow outbound access to ports 50118, 50119, and domain *.rtmpingest.mcr.teams.cloud.microsoft by January 31, 2027. Existing RTMP-In events work until end of 2026; new events require updates to avoid failure.

item.title: MC1403410: Microsoft Viva: Agent flexible query in Analytics Workbench
item.description: Microsoft Viva Insights Analytics Workbench will add a flexible query feature in late September 2026, enabling analysts to explore Microsoft 365 Copilot agent usage with customizable queries. This automatic update requires no admin action and supports data-driven decisions for organizations with over 50 Copilot licenses.

item.title: MC1466864: Call Quality Dashboard Custom Detailed Reports
item.description: Call Quality Dashboard will get a refreshed interface with enhanced accessibility and features like dark mode. Public preview starts mid-August 2026; general availability begins early September 2026. No action is needed, and users can revert to the old experience during rollout.

item.title: MC1466760: Microsoft Copilot Pages: Access existing Pages from the "/" menu in chat
item.description: Starting late August 2026, users can access existing Pages via the "/" menu in Copilot chat, while the "Edit in Pages" menu will focus on creating new Pages. This update streamlines referencing Pages without affecting existing content or permissions. No action is required.

item.title: MC1466757: Microsoft Teams: Collect information with List Form in Workflows
item.description: Microsoft Teams Workflows will add a new trigger, "A form is submitted," for automating actions based on SharePoint list–backed form responses. Rolling out September–October 2026, it enables posting responses in Teams, uses existing SharePoint governance, requires no admin action, and respects current permissions and policies.

item.title: MC1466754: Microsoft Viva Engage: Reducing reply notification volume in email
item.description: Microsoft Viva Engage will reduce email reply notifications by only sending alerts for direct replies, @mentions, and new posts, cutting down on broader conversation notifications. This change, rolling out from September to October 2026, requires no user action and keeps existing settings unchanged.

item.title: MC1454816: [Updated Date] Power Platform - Information about SharePoint file thumbnail changes
item.description: Beginning September 18, 2026, SharePoint triggers and actions that are currently returning a thumbnail URL are being updated.
