item.title: MC1466307: Microsoft Teams: Centralized notification settings for channels
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce centralized channel notification settings, allowing users to manage all channel notifications from one location. This feature, enabled by default, rolls out worldwide in October 2026, preserves existing settings, requires no admin action, and aims to simplify notification management.

item.title: MC1466302: Project Online Essentials reaches End of Life on October 1, 2026: Action required
item.description: Project Online Essentials will reach end of life on October 1, 2026. Organizations must transition users to supported licenses like Project and Planner Plan 1 or Plan 3 before then to maintain access and licensing rights for Project Online, Project Server, and Planner Premium capabilities.

item.title: MC1466296: Microsoft Teams: Report security concerns in meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a "Report a concern" feature in meetings by late 2026, allowing users to report suspicious behavior like phishing or scams. Reports, including meeting metadata, will be accessible to administrators via Microsoft Defender and Teams admin center for investigation and response. This feature is enabled by default.

item.title: MC688109: Co-organizer experience updates in Teams Webinars and Townhalls
item.description: Co-organizers in Teams Webinars and Townhalls can now fully manage events, including editing details, publishing, and canceling, achieving parity with organizers. Rollout starts mid-January 2025 for targeted release and mid-June 2026 for general availability, with no preparation needed.

item.title: MC1459131: Microsoft Teams: Prepare custom apps for private and shared channel compatibility
item.description: Microsoft Teams will roll out a feature by mid-September 2026 to help admins identify custom line-of-business apps needing updates for private and shared channel compatibility. Updating these apps ensures business continuity, reduces support issues, and maintains app access across evolving channel experiences.

item.title: MC1454108: Microsoft 365 Copilot app update: Simpler Copilot access
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot app is updating to a unified app for personal and work accounts with clearer visual cues, a simpler name and icon, and a new web URL (copilot.cloud.microsoft). Rollout begins mid-August 2026, with no changes to security, compliance, or enterprise controls.

item.title: MC1218000: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Structured document generation with Forms
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot enables structured document generation in SharePoint via Forms, requiring a Copilot license. Public preview started mid-February 2026; general availability begins October 2026. It ensures consistent, compliant documents with template governance, requires no admin action, and applies existing SharePoint permissions.

item.title: MC1422060: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Prompt injection protection for email
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will introduce prompt injection protection for email, detecting and quarantining malicious content targeting AI assistants. Rolling out from July to October 2026, it affects organizations with Defender Plan 2 or Microsoft 365 E5, enabling automatic high-confidence threat quarantine by default with no required action.

item.title: MC1247902: SharePoint: AI citations analytics for documents and pages
item.description: SharePoint will add AI copilot citation analytics for documents, pages, and news posts, showing how often content is referenced by Microsoft 365 Copilot chat. Available to tenants with over 50 Copilot licenses, rollout starts end of August 2026. No admin action is needed; site owners get new usage insights.

item.title: MC1465777: Enhanced Slide Navigation with Up and Down Arrow Keys in PPT Live
item.description: PowerPoint Live now allows slide navigation using Up and Down Arrow keys, enhancing presenter control. This update, rolling out globally from mid-August to early September 2026, requires no action but may prompt updates to training materials. Existing navigation methods remain unchanged.

item.title: MC1465773: Microsoft Viva Engage: Microsoft Entra permissions required for community and membership administration
item.description: Starting late September 2026, Microsoft Viva Engage will require Microsoft Entra permissions—Yammer Administrator role or Community Admin assignment—for community and membership management tasks previously allowed to Verified or Network Admins. Administrators should review and update role assignments accordingly.

item.title: MC1465771: Microsoft Defender XDR: DLP alerts will be set as behaviors by default
item.description: Microsoft Defender XDR will set Microsoft Purview DLP alerts as behaviors by default starting October 12, 2026, reducing alert volume while keeping DLP data accessible in Advanced Hunting and Purview. Administrators can disable this rule to retain DLP alerts in the Defender XDR incident queue.

item.title: MC1465770: General Availability of Power BI developer mode
item.description: Power BI developer mode and the PBIP file format are generally available, making PBIR the default report format in Power BI Desktop and service. This enhances source control, CI/CD, and programmatic development. PBIX remains primary, with no impact on report functionality. No user action is required.

item.title: MC1465766: Microsoft Teams: Retirement of WebRTC-based media optimization for Omnissa Horizon on Windows endpoints
item.description: Microsoft is retiring the WebRTC-based media optimization for Teams on Omnissa Horizon Windows endpoints by September 1, 2027, transitioning users to a new VDI solution with improved meeting quality and diagnostics. Users must update Horizon Client and Teams versions and complete migration by March 31, 2027.

item.title: MC1465764: Teams web client users will be redirected to teams.cloud.microsoft
item.description: Teams web users will be redirected from teams.microsoft.com to teams.cloud.microsoft by September 2026. This domain change won't affect features or existing links. Temporary admin control to disable redirect ends December 31, 2026. Organizations should update documentation and ensure network access to *.cloud.microsoft.
